title: Data Product Owner
description:
W ITLT pomagamy naszym zaprzyjaźnionym firmom przekształcać ambitne pomysły w cyfrową rzeczywistość. Z nastawieniem na wyzwania, ciekawość technologii i zwinność współtworzymy wyjątkowe rozwiązania IT i zapewniamy doświadczone osoby eksperckie, które pomagają przyspieszać cyfrową transformację.

Aktualnie poszukujemy profilu na stanowisko: Data Product Owner

Informacje organizacyjne:

  • Forma współpracy: Kontrakt B2B (bezpośrednio z IT LeasingTeam).

  • Budżet: Otwarty – dostosujemy się do Twoich oczekiwań finansowych i rynkowego doświadczenia.

  • Tryb pracy: Wysoce elastyczna hybryda (wymagana obecność w biurze w Warszawie zaledwie 1 raz w miesiącu + okazjonalne, kwartalne zjazdy na PI Planning).

  • Wymiar pracy: Full-time. Kontrakt początkowo zaplanowany do końca kwietnia 2027 roku (koniec roku finansowego klienta), z możliwością przedłużenia po akceptacji nowych budżetów. Ze względu na globalny zasięg projektu, 1-2 razy w tygodniu konieczna jest dostępność na spotkania z rynkiem USA do godziny 18:00 CET.

  • Dostępność: Start docelowo do 18 sierpnia 2026 r. (lub wcześniej).

  • Sektor: Retail / Energy / E-mobility.

  • Projekt i Twoja Rola:

    • Dołączysz do pionu Digital Experience u jednego z absolutnych, globalnych liderów nowoczesnego handlu detalicznego i e-mobility. Twój projekt będzie koncentrował się wokół analizy danych reklamowych (impressions, performance) gromadzonych z szerokiego wachlarza cyfrowych punktów styku – od sklepowych kiosków i kas samoobsługowych, po aplikacje mobilne i terminale przy dystrybutorach.

    • Słowo "Manager" w nazwie stanowiska odnosi się do Twoich kompetencji miękkich i zdolności egzekwowania celów od interesariuszy ("soft power") – nie jest to rola wiążąca się z formalnym zarządzaniem zespołem. Będziesz kluczowym pomostem pomiędzy światem biznesu (ok. 50% czasu) a technicznymi zespołami Data Engineering i Analytics (ok. 50% czasu). Nie oczekujemy od Ciebie pisania kodu produkcyjnego – Twoim celem jest definiowanie architektury, weryfikowanie logiki i zapewnienie, że właściwe dane trafiają we właściwe miejsce.

  • Do Twoich głównych obowiązków na tym stanowisku należeć będzie:

    • Bieżąca, bliska współpraca z globalnymi interesariuszami (Europa, Indie, USA) w celu zrozumienia ich potrzeb, mapowania wymagań biznesowych i przekładania ich na język techniczny dla inżynierów.

    • Prowadzenie zaawansowanych analiz ad-hoc oraz definiowanie relacji w modelach danych w środowiskach Snowflake i Databricks.

    • Pisanie złożonych zapytań SQL na potrzeby walidacji jakości danych (Data Quality) dostarczanych przez inżynierów oraz przeprowadzanie testów UAT.

    • Projektowanie architektury informacji pomiędzy poszczególnymi warstwami danych (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum).

    • Tworzenie prototypów raportów (Proof-of-Concept) w Power BI, które po weryfikacji biznesowej będą przekazywane do finalnego wdrożenia zespołom analitycznym.

    • Zarządzanie zadaniami i koordynacja prac między zespołami z wykorzystaniem narzędzi zwinnych (Jira, Confluence).

Oczekiwania:

  • Od 5 do 8 lat doświadczenia w obszarze Data Analytics, Data Systems Analysis lub Technical Product Managementu (z silnym naciskiem na dane).

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość środowisk Databricks i Snowflake (jako świadomy użytkownik / weryfikator).

  • Biegłość w pisaniu złożonych zapytań SQL – to Twoje główne narzędzie do analizy ad-hoc i weryfikacji poprawności prac inżynierskich.

  • Zrozumienie koncepcji Data Modeling oraz architektury warstwowej (Medallion Architecture) wraz z logiką agregacji na kolejnych poziomach.

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie w budowaniu dashboardów w Power BI (minimum na poziomie tworzenia makiet i PoC).

  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności komunikacyjne, dyplomacja i asertywność – potrafisz być partnerem do rozmów zarówno z deweloperami, jak i menedżerami z biznesu czy marketingu.

  • Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego – praca w 100% w anglojęzycznym, rozproszonym środowisku.

  • Mile widziane:

    • Znajomość języka Python (do szybkiej manipulacji danymi na własne potrzeby analityczne).

    • Wiedza lub wcześniejsze doświadczenie w obszarze AdTech (analiza danych z kampanii reklamowych, digital touchpoints).

Oferujemy:

  • Długofalową współpracę B2B z IT LeasingTeam.

  • Dostęp do benefitów: Multisport, ubezpieczenie PZU, opieka medyczna LuxMed.

  • Przejrzysty kontakt z rekruterem ITLT, dzięki czemu zawsze wiesz, na jakim etapie procesu jesteś – gramy w otwarte karty na każdym kroku rekrutacji.

title: Global Director of Social Data
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

Role: Global Director of Social Data

Location: London

About the role:

We seek a highly accomplished social analytics leader who combines statistical rigour with social-native thinking. You've spent 7-10+ years mastering social media measurement across major platforms; you understand algorithms, audience behaviours, and how culture moves online. You're as passionate about quantifying social impact on business as you are interpreting TikTok trends and internet subcultures. You're a strategic thinker who can translate complex data into compelling narratives for senior stakeholders. You're excited to build something – defining frameworks, selecting tech stacks, and establishing best practices that will scale globally. As an in-house agency, OLIVER is uniquely positioned alongside brands within their businesses, giving you unparalleled access to drive meaningful measurement that matters.

What you will be doing:

  • Measurement Vision & Thought Leadership:
  • Establish OLIVER/BrandTech Group's definitive POV on social media measurement for modern brands: what matters in 2026 and beyond, how to connect social activity to business outcomes, and what a mature measurement framework looks like.
  • Position our measurement capabilities as a competitive differentiator in new business pitches, translating frameworks into compelling narratives that win clients.
  • Stay ahead of platform evolution, algorithm changes, and emerging methodologies, continuously advancing our practice.
  • Champion the integration of AI and machine learning into analytics workflows - automating data processes, enhancing predictive modelling, enabling real-time trend detection, and unlocking creative performance insights at scale.
  • Enterprise Measurement Infrastructure & Products:
  • Design and implement a unified measurement system that connects all social accounts we manage globally, creating a single source of truth for social performance and brand impact across the agency.
  • Own the social analytics tech stack-evaluate, select, and manage social listening platforms, analytics tools, dashboarding solutions, and data infrastructure.
  • Develop standardised, scalable products that can be embedded across our global studios:
  • Social listening solution that delivers cultural intelligence and brand health insights
  • Social performance dashboarding product that provides consistent, actionable insights across all client accounts
  • Build sophisticated measurement frameworks including social-specific attribution models, brand lift methodologies, and predictive analytics that connect social touchpoints to awareness, consideration, and conversion.
  • Strategic Advisory & Collaboration:
  • Act as trusted advisor to senior clients and internal stakeholders, translating complex social data into strategic recommendations that drive business decisions.
  • Guide clients through measurement maturity evolution-from basic reporting to predictive modelling-building roadmaps that advance their social analytics sophistication.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with creative, strategy, and social studio leads to ensure analytics inform campaign development, creative ideation, and optimisation.
  • Work closely with data experts and leaders across BrandTech Group agencies, while leading analytics talent within the OLIVER network.
  • Team Leadership :
  • Recruit, hire, and develop a global team of social data analysts who combine technical excellence with cultural fluency-people who live in the feeds and love social media.
  • Foster a learning culture, mentoring team members on analytics methodologies, measurement frameworks, data storytelling, and client communication.
  • Lead high-impact presentations for internal teams and clients, using visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) to make dense datasets accessible and inspiring.

What you need to be great in this role:

  • Social Analytics Mastery & Platform Expertise: 7-10+ years in social media analytics or digital measurement. Deep hands-on experience across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter/X, Snapchat, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms. Expert understanding of algorithms, content formats, audience behaviors, and native analytics. Proven experience with social listening platforms (Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Pulsar). Social-native-fluent in internet culture, memes, subcultures, and how trends emerge online.
  • Advanced Measurement & Technical Skills: Track record designing measurement frameworks, attribution models, and success metrics aligned to business objectives. Advanced Excel skills. Expert with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI). Experience with multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modelling, or statistical approaches for social measurement. Familiarity incorporating AI/ML and predictive analytics into workflows.
  • Strategic Leadership & Client Advisory: Exceptional ability to advise senior stakeholders, translating data into business recommendations. Significant experience presenting complex insights with clarity and impact. Track record for building and mentoring analytics teams. Strong cross-functional collaboration with creative, strategy, and technology teams. Experience supporting new business development and articulating analytics capabilities in pitch situations.
  • Entrepreneurial Builder & Storyteller: Excited to build a practice from the ground up. Strategic thinker who balances vision-setting with hands-on execution. Intellectually curious and always pushing boundaries. Exceptional communicator who transforms complex datasets into compelling narratives. Results-driven, focused on proving measurable impact that drives client success and agency growth.

title: Technical Product Manager - Data Foundations
description:
About Us:

At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

About the team:

The Data Foundations product group comprises a suite of horizontal products / services that support both data producers and consumers in getting the most out of the platform, supporting both target segments with foundational capabilities expected out of an enterprise grade data & ML platform. Platform products like distributed compute, compute marketplace, distributed storage, Identity and Access Management, Discovery & Lineage, Privacy make up the data foundations product group.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

As a Technical Product Manager for the Lineage Sourcing product, you set the product vision, GTM strategy and drive adoption of enterprise wide lineage tooling, across OLTP and OLAP data and AI systems, and its integration with various other governance tooling like the enterprise policy platform, the enterprise knowledge graph and the enterprise wide data & AI product discovery UX.

The primary mission of this product is to enable managed sourcing of table and eventually column level lineage (where applicable) from the majority of multi-modal data production and consumption pathways across the enterprise - across data storage systems (OLTP/OLAP/HTAP) and across workloads running OLTP (Java, Python) and OLAP / HTAP workloads (Spark, dbt, python, SQL etc).

The product would roll up into multiple products / tools enterprise wide - surfacing crucial lineage information to power data & AI product discovery experiences, visibility around movement / transformation of data as it moves through systems enterprise wide, and serve multiple personas from control functions to legal functions to application developers to data / reporting analysts to data engineers and ML/AI engineers / scientists and of course governance personas across the business, which fosters trusts in the data / AI product being used, enables targeted impact analysis before a change needs to be introduced and elevates the overall trust and governance posture of the data landscape enterprise wide.

The role would require balancing value elements for the both user segments - the data & AI practitioners of the business as well as the compliance / control / legal functions. And requires a deep and wide understanding of enterprise data production and consumption patterns, in large scale distributed enterprise data systems.

The ideal candidate would bring in demonstrated experience in solving for similar problem spaces, at a similar of higher scale, and be passionate about identifying opportunities for their product(s), be deeply passionate about understanding specific needs for each segment of their target customer base, while solving for the compliance challenges around multi-modal data processing the enterprise and our users face today.

  • User-focused individual who keeps the customer at the heart of everything they do, while having strong commercial awareness.

  • Data-driven. Base your decisions on facts rather than opinions.

  • A go-getter who isn’t afraid to roll up sleeves and dives into a project to achieve success by problem solving.

  • Passionate about data & machine learning and building a platform that can be leveraged by the whole company. Constantly looking for ways to improve and streamline the capabilities.

  • Open-minded team player with excellent communication skills.

  • Agile and innovative with the tenacity to thrive in a constantly changing environment.

  • Self-motivated and results-driven with a take charge attitude to manage the full development cycle of a product.

  • Friendly, knowledgeable, and motivational to others. Open to diversity in all shapes and sizes.

Role Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Experienced with distributed data & AI Platforms, including wide and deep understanding of various distributed data processing and AI processing capabilities. Familiar with data processing in production, at scale. Understanding of batch and stream processing, as well as native cloud solutions powering such pathways.

  • Demonstrated experience in delivering 0→1 products in an enterprise data & AI platform, at a significant scale.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, matrixed product and engineering organizations, ability to navigate significant complexity, driving end user value in demanding environments.

  • Solid understanding of various data, analytical and AI assets / products (from datasets > workflows / pipelines > metrics > reports > prompts > features > agents) and how their dependencies are intertwined in a distributed data & AI platform.

  • Strong understanding of asset discovery funnels across various journeys on distributed data & AI platforms, across a wide range of personas, and how classification feeds semantic context of various assets, to make such discovery journeys more relevant, context aware.

  • Ability to identify core success metrics across various parts of data production and consumption funnels

  • Experience with public Cloud offerings (AWS and GCP) and building on top of cloud platform primitives.

  • 6+ years of experience in a Product Management, Engineering or Technology Strategy role.

  • Good knowledge of data science / analytics techniques

  • Master of making data-driven decisions, managing backlog, setting and monitoring KPIs

  • Experience with stakeholder management (finance, budgeting, team management, recruitment, external customers).

  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills are essential.

  • Ability to rapidly adapt to the evolving technology landscape, keep abreast of the rapidly evolving data and AI industry are paramount.

  • Experience with web analytics software such as Google Analytics is a plus

  • Experience running A/B tests (or exposure to A/B testing concepts) is a plus

  • Previous involvement with high traffic (50,000+ visitors per day) on the platform development side, preferably E-commerce is a plus

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave

  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)

  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit

  • Contributing to a high scale, complex, world renowned product and seeing real-time impact of your work on millions of travelers worldwide

  • Promote and drive impactful and innovative engineering solutions

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

About You

You're a compassionate, motivated and resilient individual who is passionate about supporting people to achieve their goals and live more independent, fulfilling lives. You believe in treating everyone with kindness, dignity and respect and are committed to delivering person-centred support that empowers individuals to make positive changes.

You'll enjoy working as part of a supportive team, building positive relationships and adapting your approach to meet the unique needs of each person. You will be confident communicating with a wide range of people and be able to remain calm, professional and solution-focused, even in challenging situations.

What You'll Do

As a Support Worker, you'll provide practical and emotional support to people accessing our services, helping them to build confidence, develop life skills and improve their overall wellbeing.

You'll:

  • Build positive, trusting relationships with the people you support.
  • Deliver person-centred support that focuses on strengths, aspirations and individual goals.
  • Encourage independence by supporting people to develop everyday life skills, such as budgeting, accessing local services and becoming involved in their communities.
  • Promote physical, emotional and mental wellbeing, helping people to make informed choices about their lives.
  • Empower individuals to have choice, control and an active voice in decisions that affect them.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues and partner agencies to ensure people receive coordinated, high-quality support.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential records in line with organisational policies and GDPR requirements.
  • Follow safeguarding, health and safety and risk management procedures to help create a safe and supportive environment for everyone.

title: Sales Engineer – Scientific Instrumentation & Remote Sensing
description:
Sales Engineer - Scientific Instrumentation & Remote Sensing

Location: Bolton, Massachusetts (Onsite) Travel Requirement: Up to 30% domestic, including occasional international travel Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

Headwall is seeking a motivated and technically proficient Sales Engineer to support sales growth across our portfolio of remote sensing, hyperspectral imaging, and scientific instrumentation products. This role combines technical expertise with consultative selling to identify opportunities, qualify customer requirements, develop technical solutions, and drive revenue growth within assigned markets.

The successful candidate will possess experience supporting or selling capital scientific equipment and the ability to communicate complex technical solutions to customers in research, industrial, defense, environmental, and commercial markets.

Candidates with the following backgrounds will be considered: technical sales, applications engineering, technical support. We value strong technical aptitude, customer engagement experience, and a desire to build a successful career in consultative sales.

This position is based in Bolton, Massachusetts

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage sales opportunities for Headwall's remote sensing and spectral imaging product portfolio, including hyperspectral imaging systems and scientific instrumentation.
  • Achieve assigned sales quotas, revenue objectives, and pipeline growth targets.
  • Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities through a consultative sales process.
  • Respond to inbound customer inquiries and proactively generate opportunities through outbound prospecting, referrals, conferences, trade shows, and marketing campaigns.
  • Prepare quotations, proposals, technical presentations, and product recommendations that address customer requirements.
  • Leverage technical expertise gained through applications engineering, customer support, field service, or technical service to identify opportunities for additional products and services.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and effectively communicate technical capabilities to scientific, engineering, and commercial audiences.
  • Collaborate with engineering, applications, customer support, marketing, and operations teams to develop customer solutions.
  • Support channel partners, distributors, and strategic accounts throughout the sales process.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, opportunity pipelines, forecasts, and sales activities within the CRM system.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging applications in remote sensing, spectral imaging, and scientific instrumentation.
  • Represent Headwall at customer meetings, industry conferences, workshops, and trade shows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in Instrumentation sales or applications/technical experience in analytical instrumentation, remote sensing, spectroscopy, spectral imaging
  • Engineering of scientific degree (e.g. engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Geology, Remote Sensing),
  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers to understand technical requirements and recommend technical solutions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience using CRM systems or other customer relationship management tools.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30%.
  • U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent Resident status required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling or supporting hyperspectral imaging systems, remote sensing technologies, optical instrumentation, spectroscopy, or scientific imaging systems.
  • Experience with VIS, NIR, SWIR, Raman, fluorescence, machine vision, spectroscopy, or analytical instrumentation.
  • Knowledge of optical sensing, environmental monitoring, geospatial technologies, UAV-based sensing systems, or machine vision.








Desired Attributes

The ideal candidate is:

  • Passionate about helping customers solve complex technical challenges.
  • Motivated to build a successful career in technical sales and business development.
  • Technically curious and comfortable discussing advanced scientific instrumentation.
  • Customer-focused with a consultative approach to selling.
  • Goal-oriented with a strong desire to achieve and exceed objectives.
  • Organized and capable of managing multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative and effective at working across engineering, applications, service, marketing, and commercial teams.
  • Comfortable engaging with scientists, engineers, procurement professionals, and executive decision-makers.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies and applications.

Why Join Headwall?

At Headwall, you will work alongside experts developing advanced sensing technologies used in remote sensing, machine vision, environmental monitoring, precision agriculture, mining, defense, and scientific research.

Whether your background is in technical sales, applications engineering, customer support, field service, or technical service, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in consultative technical sales while leveraging your scientific and engineering expertise. You will help customers solve complex challenges using industry-leading hyperspectral imaging and remote sensing solutions while contributing directly to Headwall's continued growth.

Headwall provides a collaborative, innovation-driven environment where technical expertise is valued, professional development is encouraged, and career growth is supported.

Automotive Alignment technicians use the latest equipment to align newly-mounted tires and wheels on customer's vehicles. title: Receiving & Distribution Specialist | PRN status
description:
This position performs efficient operations by receiving, warehousing and distributing supplies while ensuring accuracy for expenses and inventory levels as applicable to assigned area(s). Supports the organization in fulfilling the mission, vision, and values of Logan Health.

Our Mission: Quality, compassionate care for all.

Our Vision: Reimagine health care through connection, service and innovation.

Our Core Values: Be Kind | Trust and Be Trusted | Work Together | Strive for Excellence.

Logan Health is seeking a dependable and organized Receiving & Distribution Specialist to join our team in Kalispell on a PRN, as-needed basis. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys active, hands-on work, pays close attention to detail, and wants to support patient care without working in a clinical role.

In this position, you will help ensure departments throughout Logan Health receive the supplies and materials they need to operate safely and efficiently. From receiving shipments and maintaining inventory to delivering products throughout the organization, your work will make an important difference every day.

What You’ll Do

  • Receive incoming products and confirm shipments are complete and accurate.

  • Organize supplies to support safe and efficient product flow.

  • Enter receipts into the appropriate inventory system, verifying purchase orders, quantities, and packing units.

  • Deliver supplies and products to designated departments and locations.

  • Prepare packages and documentation for outgoing shipments.

  • Replenish, count, and rotate inventory according to department procedures.

  • Use computerized systems and barcode scanners to track supplies and maintain accurate inventory levels.

  • Monitor inventory levels and update computerized stock records.

  • Break down boxes and maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

  • Perform driving and delivery responsibilities when assigned.

What You’ll Bring

  • Previous experience in receiving, warehousing, inventory, distribution, or supply-chain operations is preferred.

  • Experience using barcode scanners for inventory and replenishment is preferred.

  • Basic business math skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • The ability to prioritize responsibilities and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn new software.

  • A commitment to providing high-quality work with integrity, kindness, professionalism, and respect.

  • Forklift certification when required for the assigned work area.

Candidates assigned to driving responsibilities must have a current driver’s license and an acceptable driving record for the previous 36 months. Personal vehicles used for Logan Health business must carry the minimum liability coverage required by state law.

Why Choose a PRN Role at Logan Health?

PRN positions, also known as casual, as-needed, or per-diem roles, offer flexibility while allowing you to gain valuable experience and support the team during busy periods, employee absences, and vacations.

PRN employees have access to:

  • A 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching.

  • Logan Health’s Employee Assistance Program.

  • Employee wellness resources, including wellness coaching, classes, challenges, and incentives.

  • A waived registration fee and discounted monthly membership at the Logan Health Medical Fitness Center.

  • Employee referral opportunities.

Although this position works behind the scenes, its impact is felt throughout the organization. By ensuring essential supplies reach the right departments at the right time, you will directly support Logan Health’s mission of providing quality, compassionate care for all. Apply today and help keep Logan Health moving!

Shift:

Day Shift - 8 Hours (United States of America)

Schedule:

Logan Health operates 24 hours per day, seven days per week. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

PRN positions (also referred to as Casual, As Needed, or Per Diem) at Logan Health offer flexibility and are designed to provide coverage during busy periods, employee absences, and vacations, making them an excellent opportunity to support the team as needed. PRN employees can participate in a matching 401(k) plan and have access to the Employee Assistance Program. Additionally, they may qualify for hourly differential pay for certain shifts or hours, offering extra compensation based on department-specific scheduling needs. Pay rates and scheduling practices may vary by department.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
Pitkäaikaisen työntekijämme siirtyessä eläkkeelle haemme Turun tehtaallemme uutta

KUNNOSSAPITOASENTAJAA

Valmistamme Turussa pesu- ja puhdistusaineita teollisuuteen, ammattikäyttöön ja kuluttajille. Oma 11 hengen kunnossapitotiimimme työskentelee tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon kanssa ja omalta osaltaan varmistaa tuotannon laadukkaan ja tehokkaan toiminnan. Työtä tehdään arkisin kahdessa vuorossa ja työaika on 40 tuntia viikossa.

Mitä kunnossapitoasentajan tehtäviin tuotannossa kuuluu?

Tehtävässä vastaat pakkauslinjojen tuotantolaitteiden ylläpidosta ja huollosta edistäen joustavaa ja mahdollisimman tehokasta ja häiriötöntä tuotantoa. Tehtävänäsi on huolehtia itsenäisesti tuotanto-ohjelman mukaisista tuotevaihdoista. Huolehdit aktiivisella otteella myös ajon aikaisista linjojen ja koneiden asennuksista sekä hienosäädöistä. Lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu tuotantolaitteiden tuotannonaikaisten häiriöiden selvitys ja korjaukset sekä koneiden ja laitteiden ennakkohuoltotyöt kunnossapitosuunnitelman mukaisesti. Toivomme, että tuot myös esille kehitysehdotuksia tuotantolaitteiden ja menetelmien sekä toiminnan ja laiteturvallisuuden parantamiseksi.

Jos tunnistat itsesi seuraavasta, voisit viihtyä meillä kunnossapitoasentajana:

  • Tehtävään sopiva koulutus tai alalta hankittu kokemus – Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta valmistavasta teollisuudesta ja automaattisten pakkauskoneiden kanssa työskentelystä. Tehtävässä menestymistä edesauttaa alalle soveltuva tekninen koulutus tai työssä hankittu osaaminen. Voit olla myös sähkö- tai automaatioasentaja, jos sinulla on kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta. Käyttökokemus kunnossapitojärjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi.

  • Oma-aloitteinen työote ja ryhmätyöskentelytaidot – Työtä tehdään sekä itsenäisesti että ryhmässä. Olet päivittäin tekemisissä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.

  • Into oppia uutta – Kannustamme uuden oppimiseen ja pääsetkin oman kiinnostuksesi sekä aiemman kokemuksesi mukaan kehittymään kunnossapidon moniosaajaksi.

  • Kielitaito – Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Lisäksi englannin kielen taidosta on hyötyä.

Me otamme työhyvinvoinnin tosissamme

Kiillossa pääset työskentelemään ympäristössä, joka on kiehtova yhdistelmä kasvavaa kansainvälistä ja maanläheistä perheyritystä. Työntekijämme arvostavat pitkän tähtäimen toimintatapaamme, avointa ja läpinäkyvää yrityskulttuuria, kiiltolaista yhteishenkeä sekä monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta ja kasvaa yhdessä yrityksen kanssa. Me rohkaisemme työntekijöitämme tuomaan ideoitaan esille ja kehittymään omissa innovaatio- ja koulutusohjelmissamme. Olemme erityisen ylpeitä tunnustuksista, joita olemme saaneet panostuksistamme työhyvinvointiin: meidät on valittu kahdesti Suomen aktiivisimmaksi työpaikaksi. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Muutama sana hakuprosessiin liittyen

Odotamme hakemustasi 23.8.2026 mennessä. Kerro viestikentässä tarkemmin, miksi haet ja mikä tehtävässä erityisesti kiinnostaa. Liitäthän mukaan myös CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi sekä vastaat lyhyesti hakulomakkeen lopussa olevaan videokysymykseen.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa 19.8.2026 klo 13-13.30 kunnossapitoinsinööri Antero Kotiranta, +358 40 358 3073.

Toimimme Kiillon rekrytointiprosessin mukaisesti ja käsittelemme kaikki tehtävää koskevat yhteydenotot ehdottoman luottamuksellisesti. Pyydämme hakijoita varaamaan 28.8.2026 mahdollista Turun tehtaalla pidettävää työhaastattelua varten. Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään hyväksyttyä terveystarkastusta, joka sisältää huumausainetestauksen.

description:
Title:

Director, Applied AI Solutions, N.A. Commercial

About Ipsen:

Ipsen is a mid-sized global biopharmaceutical company with a focus on transformative medicines in three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Rare Disease and Neuroscience. Supported by nearly 100 years of development experience, with global hubs in the U.S., France and the U.K, we tackle areas of high unmet medical need through research and innovation.

Join us on our journey towards sustainable growth, creating real impact on patients and society!

For more information, visit us at and follow our latest news on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Description:

The Director Applied AI Solutions – NA Commercial is responsible for defining and leading the North America Commercial AI strategy, portfolio, and roadmap to drive business performance, customer engagement, operational excellence, and innovation. This role identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities across patient finding, HCP engagement, next-best-action, insights generation, and commercial operations, translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI-enabled capabilities that deliver measurable value.

Serving as the business owner and strategic leader for Commercial AI solutions, the incumbent partners across Commercial, Data Science, Digital/IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and enterprise platform teams to drive governance, investment decisions, solution adoption, and value realization. The role provides thought leadership on emerging AI technologies, influences senior stakeholders, and ensures AI capabilities are aligned with commercial priorities, enterprise standards, and long-term growth objectives.

WHAT - Main Responsibilities

Build and deliver NA Commercial AI solutions (primary focus)

  • Design and build AI-powered workflows, agents, and applications for prioritized NA Commercial use cases, including patient finding, patient identification, HCP targeting, field insights, next-best-action, and content and insights automation.
  • Translate Commercial business problems into technical solution designs and executable delivery plans.
  • Build and test LLM, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and predictive AI solutions using approved Ipsen data and technology environments.
  • Convert analytics, models, and prototypes into scalable, compliant, and business-ready solutions that can be adopted by NA Commercial teams.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks for accuracy, grounding, hallucination risk, reliability, business KPIs, cost, and performance; iterate based on measured results.
  • Partner with the Data Science team to productionize models and prototypes and with IT/platform teams to deploy and support solutions.

Commercial use-case and product ownership

  • Partner with NA Commercial Operations, Brand, Field, Patient Services, Value & Access, and Analytics teams to identify and prioritize AI opportunities.
  • Maintain the roadmap and backlog for assigned NA Commercial AI solutions.
  • Define business requirements, user experience, adoption plans, and value measurement for solutions in scope.
  • Ensure solutions are integrated into Commercial workflows rather than delivered only as technical prototypes.
  • Gather business feedback and prioritize enhancements based on adoption and measurable impact.

AI solution and vendor evaluation

  • Conduct structured evaluations and pilots of AI tools relevant to NA Commercial use cases.
  • Define business, technical, compliance, cost, and scalability criteria; build test approaches and benchmark vendor claims.
  • Evaluate the suitability of approved platform AI capabilities, including Snowflake Cortex and Salesforce/Agentforce, for specific NA Commercial use cases.
  • Make evidence-based build-versus-buy recommendations in partnership with IT, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and relevant platform owners.

description:
About Ogilvy

Ogilvy, part of WPP, has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy 75 years ago. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. Influence Strategy Director
Large FMCG Drinks Portfolio

Department: Influence
Location: London
Contract type: Fixed-Term (12 months)
Full Time/Part time: Full Time
Reporting into: Head Of Influence Strategy


About Ogilvy:

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fueled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International.

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally and the agency also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP.

The role:

We are seeking a visionary and authoritative Influence Strategy Director to own and elevate the strategic direction for some of our largest, most prestigious clients. You are an established industry leader with proven experience operating at a Strategy Director level within an influencer agency or leading influencer strategy in-house.

As a core part of the creative strategy leadership team, you will craft consumer and corporate strategies rooted in culture that earn the right to be seen and talked about. You will act as a strategic partner to our most senior clients, helping them navigate the complex intersection of paid, earned, and owned influence.

Beyond client ownership, you will be a growth driver for the agency, playing a pivotal role in significant new business pitches and helping to secure new client wins. You will act as a collaborator with Account and Creative leads to ensure the positive direction of all client activity.

Furthermore, as a leader within the department, you will help to design ways of working, empower team autonomy, and take a hands-on approach to mentoring and line managing our talented junior and mid-level strategists.

In our world, no day, nor brief, is the same. We need someone who is comfortable with agility and fast pace, champions cross-discipline collaboration, and brings an encyclopaedic knowledge of the influencer landscape to solve our clients' toughest business problems.

The Skillset

We are looking for an influence expert who can confidently own the room, pioneer new strategic models, and drive award-winning creative output.

Defining the problem: Masterminding strategic direction and cross-discipline integration.

  • Challenges foundational assumptions and leads across disciplines so the entire picture makes sense.
  • Helps senior clients formulate better briefs, tasks, and define the true nature of their business problems.
  • Acts as an integral part of the senior client team; the definitive "go-to consultant" for influence strategy.

Insight Creation: Finding, filtering, and rethinking data to inspire categories.

  • Expert at identifying the right tensions and cultural truths; distils complex information into simple, motivating insights for influence strategy.
  • Pioneers new research techniques with clients, getting to insights that shape entire businesses and categories.
  • Able to brief, guide, and champion bespoke research methodologies when required.

Setting the Path: Giving inspiration, clarity & confidence.

  • Shapes and sells innovative influencer strategies that address complex brand and business KPIs.
  • Partners with Business Directors and Client Partners to proactively grow the scope and impact of influencer work across our biggest clients.
  • Acts as a collaborator with Account and Creative leads to ensure positive, ambitious direction of client activity.

Ideation: Helping creative & other disciplines come up with better ideas, faster.

  • Acts as an idea originator outside of main briefs, proactively seeking to develop new ideas and proactive models.
  • Originates proactive influencer briefs that inspire clients and the agency on the boundless potential of influence.
  • Articulates how an influence idea can impact all elements of a client's business, rather than just communications.

Prototyping and Storytelling: Defining, communicating & selling the idea.

  • Pioneers new ways of framing and selling an idea, consistently using compelling narratives and soundbites.
  • Develops highly persuasive, memorable decks that frame complex strategies simply and powerfully for C-suite and Board-level stakeholders.
  • Commands the room during major new business pitches, using narrative and visuals to win over senior stakeholders and secure new client wins.

Manifesting the Work: Crafting the experience journey and delivery detail.

  • Influences senior clients into experimenting with new influencer channels, formats, content, and technology.
  • Develops comprehensive influencer roadmaps that dictate how an idea can evolve over three to five years.
  • Ensures smooth integration of earned-first ideas across paid and owned ecosystems.

Measurement and Effectiveness: Proving value and setting industry standards.

  • Showcases recognised expertise linked to proving the value of influencer ideas to major organizations.
  • Sets up projects for integrated evaluation from the start, differentiating between helpful and unhelpful data.
  • Authors case studies, contributes to effectiveness reports, and sets new benchmarks for influencer effectiveness.

Team Leadership & Development: Cultivating a high-performing strategy team.

  • Line manages, mentors, and develops a team of junior and mid-level strategists, championing a culture of continuous learning.
  • Designs ways of working that support effective resource management, ensuring fair distribution of workload during peak periods or complex campaigns.
  • Acts as the ultimate escalation point for complex issues, coaching the team in decisive problem-solving and proactive pre-planning.
  • Empowers team autonomy while remaining responsible for overall team performance and maintaining transparent communication with agency leadership.


How we help you Thrive:

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm
  • A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure
  • Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM


TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

The Field Applications Engineer is responsible for technical support to customer's PCB design and manufacturing groups. This position will support customers PCB designers early-on in the design cycle and provide feedback on routing and lay out techniques, offer cost trade-off analysis of PCB stack-ups, material selection, reliability, signal integrity and other electrical and mechanical requirements based on the customers end use application.

East Coast-based candidates are preferred.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFV (Design for Value) support to customer engineering and design teams for new designs and existing design improvement with a focus on reducing customers design cycle time
  • Collaborate with customer designers to improve quality and completeness of their design packages and help them by identifying design problems related to manufacturability and reliability test
  • Support drawing reviews prior to design release and help architect drawing notes to support the specific design and manufacturing needs
  • Thorough knowledge of industry specification (IPC) requirements as well as customer developed specifications requirements
  • Update customer design and manufacturing groups on TTM capabilities and technology roadmap through formal presentations
  • Provide TTM manufacturing facilities insight into future customer needs, technology requirements and identify gaps in TTMs ability to support those future needs. Facilitate customer technical needs with TTM engineering and operations
  • Assist TTM site pre-production teams through the stack-up/DFM/TQ approval process and in getting “on-hold” issues addressed on the customer side expeditiously
  • Thorough understanding of TTM manufacturing and design capabilities and value add offerings to support QTA/NPI/Production Manufacturing for Aerospace & Defense customers
  • Establish technical contacts between customer and TTM to drive improved lines of technical communications and increased depth of relationships
  • Assist the Sales Account Managers in increasing customer revenue by providing technical support and service
  • Travel to and visit customer sights to support technical discussions, issues, and key programs as required.
  • Create and conduct technical capability presentations in conjunction with the sales team
  • This position will interface regularly with TTM’s Sales, Development, Pre-Production Engineering departments, and Operations, and it is essential that the employee be able to effectively balance the communication channels between these departments

Essential Skills and Knowledge:

  • Develop a thorough understanding of TTM manufacturing and design capabilities and value add offerings to support QTA/NPI/Production Manufacturing for Aerospace & Defense customers
  • Ability to establish contacts and build relationships with customers to drive improved communication and partnership
  • Ability to make routine decisions with general direction provided by department Manager
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to work well with customers design groups
  • Strong printed circuit engineering background and knowledge of entire PCB manufacturing process including process flows, individual processing steps, and pre-production tooling
  • Self-motivated and willing to work with minimum supervision
  • Effective public speaking and presentation skills

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline preferred
  • 5-7+ years of experience in engineering activities related to PCB manufacturing preferred
  • Intermediate level skills using PCB CAM software, drawing / blueprint interpretation skills, and use of PCB stack-up tools
  • Minimum level experience of electrical design performance and signal integrity (Impedance, RF, and Insertion loss)
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Microsoft Project
  • Travel for customer visits and TTM North American sites required up to 25% of the time

#LI-PS1

#ADBU


Compensation and Benefits:

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available 1st of the month following date of hire.


Compensation for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience. As required by local law, TTM provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in New York, California and Colorado. For California-based roles, compensation ranges are based upon specific physical locations.

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Level 2
description:
Summary: The Bin Optimizer is responsible for maintaining accurate inventory placement, ensuring warehouse zone compliance, and optimizing bin utilization to support efficient warehouse operations. This role requires attention to detail, adherence to SOPs, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Inventory Accuracy

  • Maintain bin accuracy greater than or equal to 99% during cycle counts and audits

  • Ensure all SKUs are stored in correct bin locations per WMS (SAP)

  • Identify and correct inventory discrepancies promptly

  • Warehouse Zone Conformity

  • Achieve 100% compliance with assigned warehouse zones

  • Store inventory within designated racking, flow lanes, or floor locations

  • Ensure all bin labels are visible, correct, and scannable

  • Complete slotting changes according to approved plans

  • Organization & Housekeeping

  • Maintain assigned areas clean and organized daily

  • Remove debris, empty packaging, and excess materials from bin locations

  • Promptly remove materials on destroy or obsolete status

  • Damage & Safety Control

  • Identify and report damaged product, bins, or racking immediately

  • Maintain zero preventable safety incidents caused by storage or bin condition

  • Bin Optimization & Space Utilization

  • Utilize bin capacity efficiently (avoid chronic underfill or overfill)

  • Position high-velocity SKUs for optimal access

  • Complete re-slotting tasks within assigned timeframe

  • Work to reduce non-productive bin moves over time

  • Process Compliance & Communication

  • Follow SOPs 100% of the time

  • Communicate issues clearly to Inventory Control or Leadership

  • Maintain accurate documentation of bin changes and corrections

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives

title: Senior Field Process Engineer
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

At Lam, as a Field Process Engineer you are a customer-focused expert on our equipment, pushing the boundaries to meet customer needs. You play a vital role in supporting the customer in installations, training, and identifying design improvements with product groups. Your portfolio includes providing on-site support at customer sites which include being familiar with customer wafer fabrication processing flow and techniques, addressing potential integration challenges with systems which impact or are being impacted earlier or later in the process flow. This includes Design of Experiment (DOE), process evaluation and documentation of process outputs relating to hardware installations, medications / upgrades to existing systems.

What you’ll do

  • Work closely with Account team and customers to understand customer technology roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues / challenges. Identify areas where Lam is able to value-add.
  • Work with Account team and customers to execute to penetration and defense strategy, including coordinating with Global Product Group on product demonstration
  • Perform startup of “capacity add” Lam systems i.e. match results to existing systems and applications
  • Design and complete simple DOE evaluations to characterize process window for new installations or Lam recommended field hardware modifications / upgrades
  • Conduct experiments and tests, collect and analyze data and generate reports for both internal and external distribution
  • Develop new processes to new and/or existing customer applications
  • Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company’s product lines and services to keep existing / potential customers informed when new/additional needs are identified
  • Develop good customer relations during start-up and trouble-shooting
  • Maintain company’s assigned equipment (computer, tool kit, diagnostic test equipment, spare parts etc) in good working condition, secure and accounted for
  • Ensure safe working condition at work site
  • Any other duties as assigned by the Immediate Supervisor

Who we’re looking for

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD in Electronics, Chemistry, Physics, Material Science, or related field; or Masters of Science with 3+ years of relevant work experience; or Bachelors of Science with 5+ years of work experience.
  • Good communication and interpersonal relations skill
  • Able to actively engage customers on technical solutions
  • Able to work in Fab environment and perform standby duties
  • Must be able to wear personal protective clothing which comprises of air respirator equipment, clean room garments and safety shoes
  • Willing to support short term, overseas assignment

Preferred qualifications

  • In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Foundational analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Surveyor/Senior Surveyor | Commercial Property Asset Management - Bristol
description:
Who are we

Founded in 1896, Knight Frank was registered as Knight Frank LLP a Limited Liability Partnership, on 3 November 2003, registered in England & Wales at 55 Baker Street, London, W1U 8AN with the registered number of OC305934. Headquartered in London, UK, Knight Frank is one of the world's leading independent real estate consultancies. We work responsibly in partnership to enhance people's lives and environments in over 50 Markets, 600+ Offices, 20,000+ People, 1 Global Network.

At the heart of all we do are our Clients. A relationship built on trust is vital. As trusted partners in property, we act with integrity and care, understanding our clients’ unique needs and consistently thinking about the bigger picture to provide personalised, clear and considered advice across all areas of property. Through our deep understanding of key markets and sectors – both emerging and established – we are dedicated to meeting and exceeding their property goals.

A true partnership is a balanced one, and our People are passionate about, and committed to, making our business inclusive and diverse. We give every individual the space and opportunity to perform at their best and be recognised for the immense value they bring. We empower everyone to have autonomy in their role and encourage them to use their voice in how we can make a positive impact as a firm and shape the future of real estate, the built environment and the impact on the communities we serve. Our collaborative and engaged teams provide excellent and dedicated client service. In our workplace, opinions are respected, everyone is invited to contribute to the success of our business and innovation, and new ideas are celebrated.

In 2021 we celebrated our 125th anniversary and set out Our Desired Future, cemented in three pillars: People Potential, Client Centricity and always Creating our Future, together. Learn more about what sets us apart here.

About The Role

Our Bristol Property Asset Management team is looking to recruit a Surveyor or Senior Surveyor to support the management of a diverse regional property portfolio. This is an excellent opportunity to join a high-performing team and develop your career within one of the UK's leading property consultancies.

Working as part of a dynamic asset management team, you will be responsible for providing proactive property and asset management services across a predominantly commercial portfolio. You will work closely with clients, occupiers, consultants and internal teams to deliver exceptional service and maximise asset performance.

The role offers exposure to a broad range of responsibilities, including asset management, leasing, property management, development projects and client reporting, making every day varied and rewarding.

Depending on experience, the successful candidate will take ownership of specific assets and client relationships while contributing to wider portfolio initiatives and business development opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive asset and property management across a mixed-use regional portfolio.
  • Support the development and implementation of asset management strategies to enhance asset value and performance.
  • Deliver high-quality client reporting and property management advice.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, occupiers and professional advisers.
  • Manage lease events, including rent reviews, lease renewals, re-gears and other landlord and tenant matters.
  • Identify opportunities to improve income, reduce costs and enhance asset value.
  • Liaise with client accountants to review rent raising reports and ensure accurate rent and service charge management.
  • Work alongside credit control teams to assist with rent collection, arrears management and recovery strategies.
  • Assist with the preparation and review of annual service charge budgets and reconciliations.
  • Instruct and liaise with building managers, facilities management teams and consultants regarding repairs, maintenance programmes and refurbishment projects.
  • Coordinate annual insurance renewals and support the management of insurance claims.
  • Conduct regular property inspections and act as a key point of contact for occupiers.
  • Manage tenant applications, including alterations, assignments, sublettings and wayleaves, working closely with legal advisers where required.
  • Support leasing and disposal transactions, liaising with agency teams and external advisers.
  • Produce concise, accurate reports and present recommendations to clients.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Knight Frank to identify opportunities to enhance client service and cross-sell services.
  • Develop a strong understanding of landlord and tenant legislation, market trends and industry best practice.
  • Apply knowledge of the RICS Professional Statement: Service Charges in Commercial Property in day-to-day activities.
  • Undertake additional duties as required by Partners and senior management.

Professional Experience and Personal Skills Profile

Qualifications

  • Degree educated or equivalent relevant experience.
  • MRICS qualified or working towards qualification.
  • Full UK driving licence (essential).

Experience

  • Experience within commercial property management, asset management or a related property discipline.
  • Exposure to commercial property portfolios and landlord and tenant matters.
  • Knowledge of property management systems and reporting tools.
  • Experience across multiple asset classes would be advantageous.

Skills and Attributes

  • Strong analytical and financial skills, with a high level of competency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Commercially minded with a proactive, solutions-focused approach.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective client relationships.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive and professional attitude.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional client service.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable and eager to develop professionally.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to take ownership of responsibilities.

This is an opportunity to join one of the UK's most respected property consultancies, working with market-leading clients on a diverse portfolio of assets. You'll benefit from a collaborative culture, excellent development opportunities and the chance to build a long-term career within a highly successful national Asset Management business.

Experience, insight and ambition are what matter most. Whether you are an established Surveyor looking for your next challenge or a Senior Surveyor seeking greater responsibility, we would love to hear from you. For more details on our Bristol office, please click here.

title: Senior Client Partner, Games & Entertainment
description:
The opportunity

A Senior Client Partner is accountable for orchestrating the relationship, success, and revenue growth of Gaming & Entertainment accounts. This role requires a blend of executive presence, adaptability, and leadership to drive cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes.

What you'll be doing

Revenue Growth & Targets/KPI’s

  • Proactively identify, qualify, and close high-value opportunities within your portfolio to achieve revenue targets and strategic objectives.

  • Own all commercial activities: net new deals, renewals, contract negotiations, pricing/terms, order management, and fulfilment of products/services.

  • Responsible for developing and driving growth in the French gaming market.

Account Management & Customer Obsession

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of each studio's needs, pain points, projects, roadmap, and monetisation plans — serving as the internal voice of the studio and positioning Unity as a strategic long-term partner.

  • Build and nurture trust-based relationships across all levels of client organisations, from development teams through C-level executives and key decision-makers.

  • Ensure consistent, proactive engagement with your priority accounts through virtual, on-site, and industry events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

  • Set clear prioritisation across accounts and partner with internal technical teams to drive developer success and revenue expansion.

  • Execute deals through the deal pipeline and maintain accurate forecasting in Clari and SFDC.

  • Orchestrate Unity's technical resources across critical projects to ensure commitments are delivered and to drive deep technical partnership with customers.

What we're looking for

  • Deep empathy for developers and a genuine curiosity about how games are made and how Unity's products create value.

  • Proven track record in enterprise sales or strategic account management, ideally within the gaming, technology, or developer tools space.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder relationships with demonstrated success managing revenue growth in a portfolio.

  • Executive presence with the ability to engage and influence C-suite and senior decision-makers.

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.

You might also have

  • Native French speaker, with a strong knowledge of the gaming market in France

  • Proficiency in G Suite

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Clari

title: Butikssäljare - Göteborg Korsgatan
description:

Som medarbetare på Ur&Penn arbetar du med både service och hantverk. Du arbetar med försäljning av klockor och smycken, samt med enklare reparationer av klockor, som tex batteribyten och korta armlänkar. Vi har ett högt tempo med kunden i fokus! En stor del av arbetsuppgiften handlar om att driva den dagliga försäljningen genom kundservice och merförsäljning.

Vi söker dig som på kort varsel kan hoppa in och arbeta extra i vår butik på Korsgatan. Möjlighet till extraarbete i närliggande butiker ges också.

Vi tror att du är en energisk lagspelare med ett stort driv, och intresserar dig för mode och våra produkter. Vi tror att du beskriver dig själv som ansvarsfull, initiativtagande och tävlingsinriktad! Är du också serviceinriktad med ett “customer first” mindset, så skulle vi kunna passa bra ihop! Hos oss är intern utveckling viktigt och vi hoppas att du vill utvecklas och växa inom Ur&Penn!

GRUNDLÄGGANDE KRAV

Flytande svenska i tal och skrift. 

MERITERANDE

     •  Tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet inom detaljhandel
     •   En fullständig gymnasieutbildning.
     •   Ytterligare språkkunskap utöver svenska.

Ur&Penn, med ca 120 butiker, är idag Skandinaviens ledande kedja inom klockor, smycken och modeaccessoarer! Ur&Penn är ett företag där samarbete står i fokus, och vi lever efter våra värdeord; glädje, tillit och vinnande attityd. 

Som medarbetare hos oss blir du en kugge i det vi kallar för vår utökade familj! Vi erbjuder en fartfylld vardag i en organisation som är i ständig rörelse. Vår vision är att vara förstahandsvalet för alla som vill smycka och uttrycka sin personlighet med kvalitativa och prisvärda accessoarer.

Processen består av ett första urval. Sedan följer en digital och fysisk intervju samt kontroll av belastningsregister. 

Intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan! Sista ansökningsdag är 7/8 men tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig, vi ses på Ur&Penn!

title: Production Control Dispatcher (HMGMA) (4857)
description:
Department: Production Control Location: Ellabell, GAJob Type: FT ExemptShift: 2nd Shift (4:30 PM - 1:00 AM EST)Reports to: Logistics Manager/Dispatcher Manager

Job Summary:

The Production Control Dispatcher is responsible for coordinating the flow of inventory and parts in a Tier 1 auto parts manufacturing environment. This role ensures that materials move efficiently through the production process while maintaining quality standards and accuracy:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Track Inventory: Monitor the status and location of inventory and parts throughout the production process to ensure timely availability.

  • Move Parts: Transport parts between departments, ensuring they are delivered on schedule to maintain production flow.

  • Maintain Records: Keep accurate records of quality reports, invoices, packing slips, and other relevant documentation.

  • Update Production Status: Communicate production issues and updates to the production team, ensuring all stakeholders are informed.

  • Ensure Inventory Accuracy: Conduct regular checks to maintain the accuracy of factory and floor stock inventory.

  • Implement Lean Principles: Utilize lean manufacturing principles to optimize the movement of materials and reduce waste.

  • Ensure Quality Control: Verify that packing and transportation meet the company's quality control standards.

  • Check Health and Safety: Ensure compliance with health and safety guidelines within the dispatching process.

  • Scheduling and Routing: Prepare daily work schedules, assign loads, map locations, and direct routes for efficient dispatching.

  • Relay Information: Communicate essential information to work crews, supervisors, and emergency personnel as needed.

  • Organize Work Requests: Keep and organize work requests, customer requests, and other relevant information.
