title: Teamchef 2:a färskvaror förpackat, Willys Stockholm Mariahallen
description:
Vi är alla olika. Och det är härligt! Vi anställer inte människor efter en viss mall utan efter vem du är. För oss är driv och personlighet viktigare än erfarenhet och bakgrund. Det går bra för oss, och vi växer så det knakar. Nu söker vi fler glada medarbetare med rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas!

Om jobbet

Vi söker dig som gillar mat, människor och försäljning och vill bli en del av vårt härliga gäng på Willys Stockholm Mariahallen! Tjänsten innebär kort och gott att du bidrar till att våra kunder kan handla bra och hållbar mat till riktigt bra priser, samtidigt som du förbereds att ta klivet till att bli en ledare på Willys.

Tjänsten avser: Tillsvidareanställning, heltid. Provanställning tillämpas

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Arbetstider: Du kommer att variera mellan att arbeta tidig morgon, dagtid, kvällar och helger

Krav: Gymnasial utbildning, goda kunskaper i svenska (tal och skrift). Vi välkomnar sökande i alla åldrar, men med hänvisning till Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter AFS 2023:2 kapitel 8 och bilaga 2, anställer vi inte personer under 18 år beroende på arbetsuppgifternas art.

Här kommer lite mer om tjänsten:

  • Du är en lagspelare med mer ansvar än andra i ditt team, men utan att ha teamchefens fulla personalansvar.
  • Tillsammans med din teamchef leder och planerar du verksamheten i ert team. Självklart tar du aktivt del i det dagliga operativa butiksarbetet.
  • Du lär dig de kunskaper och färdigheter som krävs för att så småningom axla en roll som teamchef. Det här är en språngbräda för att ta dig vidare i din Willys-karriär med målet att bli en framtida teamchef eller kanske så småningom butikschef?
  • Du arbetar målinriktat för att utveckla butikens försäljning, lönsamhet och övriga viktiga nyckeltal.
  • Du ingår i arbetsledningen i butiken och har teamchefens arbetsbeskrivning på din utvecklingsplan. Du praktiserar de färdigheter som du har lärt dig i arbetet och genom utbildningar.
  • Du är en förebild i arbetet med att möta våra kunder med kunskap, fingertoppskänsla och ett stort leende.

Om oss

För oss är rätt inställning och vilja att utvecklas viktigare än erfarenhet och utbildning. Vi jobbar tillsammans som ett lag, då vi ser att ett riktigt bra samarbete ger det bästa resultatet – samtidigt som vi har kul på jobbet. Lite mer om oss kommer här:

  • Vi arbetar med konceptstyrning och kedjedrift – det finns tydliga rutiner och strukturer på plats, vilket frigör tid för dig att fokusera på att utveckla dig mot att bli teamchef och bistå din teamchef med att arbetsleda teamet.
  • Willys är ett av branschens mest framgångsrika företag och vi fortsätter att växa. Och eftersom vi växer, kan du också göra det. Som ett stort företag finns många möjligheter att utvecklas i din ledarroll hos oss, bland annat genom en rad olika utbildningar.
  • Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här.

Om dig

Du gillar mat, människor och försäljning lika mycket som vi! Willys växer och utvecklas hela tiden, och det gillar du också att göra. Du vill gärna lära dig nya saker, tycker om att utmanas och drivs av att ta ett större ansvar. Det är också toppen om:

  • Du är junior i ditt ledarskap och behöver inte ha erfarenhet från en ledarroll, men ser dig som en framtida ledare och drivs av att leda andra. Alternativt har du redan erfarenheten, men inte inom dagligvaruhandeln.
  • Du är bra på att kommunicera, tycker om att engagera dina kollegor och är bra på att skapa ett positivt arbetsklimat.
  • Du gillar människor, sätter kundens behov först och är bra på att få med dig folk – såväl kunder som medarbetare.


Om du vill veta mer om vad tjänsten innebär, kontakta Simon Wangel, Simon.wangel@willys.se. Vi ser gärna att du vid intresse skickar din ansökan så snart som möjligt, då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag den 2026-08-19. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via våra jobbsidor.

Vi kontrollerar ID och gör bakgrundskontroller vid samtliga rekryteringar. Läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood

title: French Speaking Programme Manager
description:
Are you a bilingual Programme Manager with a passion for driving large-scale data engagements?

Location: Remote first in UK but will involve travel to client locations in France
Start date: January 2027
Contract length: 12 month contract
Day rate: Competitive

At Colibri Digital, we are seeking an Engagement Lead to take programmatic ownership of a mission-critical programme within a complex, francophone environment.

This is a role for a strategic operator who thrives in the details of delivery—from RAID management and forecasting to high-level governance. As the first tier of our escalation path, you will work side-by-side with the client Project Manager, facilitate monthly Steering Committee sessions chaired by the Programme Sponsor, and act as a senior voice for the programme alongside the Chief Data Officer.

Because our domain—covering public procurement, land, planning, construction, corporate registry, and press data—is entirely in French, this role requires more than just oversight; it requires fluency. To be successful, you must be capable of chairing governance forums, navigating complex commercial and contractual discussions, and authoring client-facing documentation to a professional standard in French. You will be the bridge between our distributed team across the UK and France and the heart of the client’s data initiative.
  • Programmatic Delivery Leadership: Own the end-to-end delivery plan, acting as the single source of truth while sequencing 40+ concurrent data product workstreams.
  • Strategic Governance: Run the full cadence of project governance, from daily stand-ups and sprint ceremonies to monthly Steering Committees and phase-gate reviews.
  • Cross-Functional Assurance: Maintain the joint RAID log, manage change control, and ensure all project artefacts (architecture, non-functional requirements, test strategy) are current.
  • Capacity & Resource Management: Oversee the full resourcing lifecycle—from mobilisation to ramp-down—while tracking effort, forecasting completion, and managing parallel embedded squads.
  • Risk & Dependency Oversight: Own the end-to-end risk register and manage critical cross-programme dependencies, particularly across cross-border, multi-country initiatives.
  • Bilingual Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for client leadership, facilitating communication, governance forums, and documentation in both French and English.
  • Translation of Business Domains: Bridge the gap between the francophone business domain and UK-based delivery capability, ensuring technical and business requirements are aligned.
  • Cross-Border Team Culture: Foster a cohesive, remote-embedded team culture across France and the UK, proactively managing time-zone friction and coordination.
  • Knowledge Transfer & Quality Ownership: Execute the knowledge transfer plan, ensure adherence to quality gates at every phase, and oversee final project closure and acceptance.
  • Regulatory & AI Compliance: Apply sustainability and Responsible AI assessments where applicable, ensuring all regulatory obligations are met through diligent governance.
  • Full professional fluency in English and French (spoken and written).
  • Recognised programme management certification — MSP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP or equivalent.
  • Agile certification — Scrum Master, SAFe or equivalent. The engagement runs two-week sprints with full agile ceremonies.
  • Eight or more years managing complex, multi-workstream technology programmes, with at least three at genuine programme rather than project level.
  • Proven delivery of data platform or large-scale data migration programmes — Databricks, Spark or comparable lakehouse estates.
  • Track record running supplier-led governance from within a consultancy or systems integrator, accountable end-to-end to a client executive rather than reporting into a client PMO.
  • Demonstrable ownership of Time and Materials commercials: capped T&M, drawdown arrangements, burn tracking, day-rate resource models and timesheet-evidenced billing.
  • Formal change control end-to-end — raising Change Requests, producing impact assessments to a five-day service level, and taking changes through Board and Steering to signature.
  • Leading remote, cross-border delivery squads across at least two countries, with the cultural and time-zone judgement that requires.
  • Establishing governance from a standing start — building the cadence, artefacts and reporting rhythm on a new engagement rather than inheriting a running one.

title: Communication Technician II
description:
Department

OPS ITS - Voice Operations


About the Department

IT Services (ITS) collaborates with campus partners to support the mission of the University of Chicago through the consistent delivery of high-quality solutions and services. We provide secure, stable, and reliable infrastructure and applications that support the mission of the University. ITS supports and enables faculty research and teaching with the effective use of technology, simplifies the technology experience for all users, and identifies, manages, and mitigates technology risks for the University.


Job Information

Job Summary:

Under minimum supervision, this individual performs the maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of communications voice equipment and systems for all sites administered and maintained by the University of Chicago and UChicago Medical Center under the general direction of the Voice Operations Technical Lead and the established reporting structure. Responsible for providing Tier 1 and 2 support and participating in a rotation of 24/7 support, (on call). This position will work on projects as requested by management.

Responsibilities:

  • Makes decisions outside of established procedures affecting the system's operation, if needed.
  • Monitors, diagnoses and implements the repair of communications networks, equipment, and software in accordance with established procedures. Performs routine preventive system maintenance.
  • Diagnoses carrier-related problems, including digital and analog circuits, and reports status and repairs needed. Reports issues and opens tickets with carrier services. Follows up to completion.
  • Assists carriers with access to University of Chicago closets and equipment.
  • Installs communications equipment to board level or as instructed. Functions as the on-site person to work with voice engineers, voice specialists, inventory staff, network team and vendors.
  • Responds to customer questions and inquiries regarding features and functions of the communications system.
  • Enters incident and request tickets in our ITSM tool, ServiceNow, and properly documents tickets to capture an accurate history of events with the relevant details.
  • Maintains service activity documentation, which includes all maintenance activity performed on communications hardware and software as well as parts usage figures. Monitors inventory levels and alerts Inventory Coordinator when additional supplies and equipment is needed.
  • Guides and assists new Communication Technicians in training, orientation and proficiency growth in the University’s voice systems and procedures.
  • Provides coverage for all remote sites, such as Ingalls, Northwest Indiana, etc..
  • Maintains work area in an orderly manner.
  • Works on special projects as needed.

Competencies:

  • Interpret and analyze complex technical drawings, schematics, and documentation.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to document technical information and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong customer service skills to build and maintain effective working relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills to manage multiple assignments and work independently.
  • Work effectively in a multi-shift, multi-location environment.

Additional Responsibilities

Education, Experience, or Certifications:

Education:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associates degree in electronics or related field.
  • Graduate of a technical school.

Experience:

  • Minimum three years of experience troubleshooting and resolving issues with voice communications infrastructure, including voice gateways, carrier circuits, and DMARC’s required.
  • Background in academic and/or healthcare environments is preferred.

Certifications and Licenses:

  • I.B.E.W. Local 134 Communications Technicians in good standing with the union.
  • Valid driver's license required.
  • Familiar with Cisco Unified Communications Manager and Cisco Unity technologies to troubleshoot and resolve service issues preferred.
  • Familiar with Cisco UCCX-related technologies, call center, including Finesse for troubleshooting agent issues is preferred.

Technical Knowledge or Skills:

  • Proficient in computer, spreadsheet, and database applications.
  • Proficient in use of hand/power tools and test equipment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of digital and analog circuitry and data transmission technologies.
  • Proficiency in using basic computer hardware, software, and communications test equipment, including transmission test sets, digital multimeters, tone/pulse linesman test sets, traceable tone-tone generators, tone tracers, remote maintenance terminals, time domain reflectometers (TDR), optical test equipment, and DS1/DS3 test equipment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and experience using ServiceNow or a comparable IT Service Management (ITSM) platform.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily works in a standard office environment with regular use of computers and other office technology.
  • May be required to work flexible business hours, including occasional after-hours support and participation in a limited on-call rotation.
  • Remain in a stationary position,sitting or standing, for extended periods and move throughout office and campus locations as needed.
  • Bend, crouch, or stoop when installing, inspecting, or servicing equipment.
  • Perform repetitive hand, wrist, and finger movements associated with computer and technical equipment use.
  • Effectively communicate and accurately perceive information through visual and auditory means, including reading technical documentation, distinguishing colors, and recognizing verbal communications and equipment signals.
  • Lift, carry, push, or pull equipment and materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

title: Hygienist Full Time
description:
Job Purpose:

Registered Dental Hygienists are assigned duties and responsibilities which involve licensed professional work providing dental hygiene services. A Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH) implements appropriate standard of care therapy, assists a dentist in providing hygiene, periodontal or dental care and treatment, provides dental hygiene assessments, creates treatment plans based on a dentist's diagnosis, and provides oral and overall health care education and instruction to patients.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assess patients' teeth, bone, and periodontal tissues indicating the presence of any abnormalities or suspected diseases or conditions.
  • Creates periodontal treatment plans based on the dentist's diagnosis.
  • Bring to the immediate attention of the dentist any suspected lesion in the mouth or on the teeth.
  • Thoroughly remove soft and hard deposits and extrinsic stain from teeth, using hand instruments, ultrasonic cavitron inserts, and prophy handpieces.
  • Instruct patients on good oral hygiene practices, recommend appropriate products or devices for patients' home care, and provide other health care education, as necessary.
  • Perform prophylaxis in the absence of periodontal disease or gingivitis.
  • Perform full mouth debridement, either as a first stage gingivitis therapy or to remove interfering calculus to further enable a more accurate diagnosis and treatment plan.
  • Perform scaling and root planning as a periodontal therapy.
  • Place locally administered antibiotics as supportive periodontal therapy.
  • Implement irrigation and desensitizing procedures or products as adjunctive to periodontal therapy.
  • Position and expose dental and carpal radiographic film and sensors.
  • Perform in-office whitening procedures, including first application of gel, curing the gel, and subsequent applications.
  • Apply cavity-preventive agents, such as fluorides and pit and fissure sealants.
  • Make recommendations as to patients' re-care interval and follow-up needs.
  • All other duties and responsibilities as assigned and allowed under applicable Florida state laws and regulations.

Background Screening Requirement (Florida):
If this is a FL position, the State of Florida requires completion of a Level 2 background screening through the Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA). If you do not currently have an active Level 2 screening, our Onboarding Specialist will coordinate and schedule the screening for you.

For additional information, please visit the Florida Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse:

In accordance with HB 531.

title: Skadebehandler - Tab af erhvervsevne
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Skadebehandler - Tab af erhvervsevne

Hvis du ønsker: et job med faglig tyngde - ansvar for komplekse personskader – at være en del af et team, der faktisk spiller hinanden gode - så har vi måske den helt rette mulighed til dig!

Hos Sedgwick bliver du en del af en international koncern med stærke faglige rammer – og samtidig et lokalt team i Ballerup, hvor samarbejde, sparring og relationer er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vi er skadebehandlingspartner for offentlige selvforsikrede kunder og forsikringsselskaber og håndterer bl.a. arbejdsskader, voldsskader, EAL-sager og ulykkessager. Vores kunder vælger os, fordi vi skaber værdi gennem høj faglighed, kvalitet i sagsbehandlingen og ordentlighed i mødet med både kunder og skadelidte.

Her får du mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse personskader i et miljø, hvor faglighed og menneskelig forståelse går hånd i hånd.

"Hos os bliver der lyttet til ideer, ønsker om udvikling og behov i hverdagen. Det giver både motivation og lyst til at udvikle sig i virksomheden." - Kasper Langstrup, skadebehandler

Gør en forskel for vores kunder

I denne rolle som skadebehandler får du:

  • Kompleks skadebehandling med fokus på kvalitet, fremdrift og korrekt vurdering
  • Selvstændigt ansvar for egen portefølje af Tab af erhvervsevne-sager
  • Tæt dialog med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og relevante interessenter
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udvikling af arbejdsgange, kvalitet og faglig praksis

Teamet arbejder tæt sammen, og vi bruger den daglige sparring som et vigtigt redskab. Samtidig er det vigtigt, at du kan drive dine egne sager sikkert og selvstændigt.

Erfaren og selvstændig skadebehandler

Du formår at lytte til skadelidte og møde dem med empati i svære situationer samtidig med, at du har respekt for kundens behov for en korrekt og professionel skadebehandling i overensstemmelse med forsikringsbetingelserne. Desuden bidrager du med:

  • solid erfaring med behandling af tab af erhvervsevne-sager
  • erfaring med at samarbejde med læger og andre sundhedsfaglige kollegaer med henblik på at understøtte skadelidtes vej tilbage i arbejde.
  • erfaring med fastsættelse af korrekte reserver og planlægning af udgifter til forventede forsørgertabsperioder.

Du bidrager positivt til faglig sparring og udvikling i teamet, mens du selvstændigt tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

Hvad værdsætter kollegaerne i Personskade ved vores afdeling?

  • Vi går op i både faglighed og trivsel, og det kan mærkes i hverdagen
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden
  • En rolle med ansvar, faglig dybde og mulighed for at påvirke kvaliteten i skadebehandlingen
  • Faglig udvikling og videreuddannelse
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og hjemmearbejde op til 2 dage om ugen

Hvad venter du på?

Kan du se dig selv som en del af Sedgwick, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at ringe eller sende en mail til Leder af Personskade Lotte Ruby Schartau, tlf. 30 37 89 08, Lotte.schartau@sedgwick.com.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics? Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics.

At Qnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. Key Responsibilities:

Lead Manufacturing System Development:​ Follow standardized development processes to lead or participate in project development for manufacturing systems (such as MES, SCADA, WMS, CMMS, etc.), including software design, coding, code reviews, application of standards, and testing.

Business Analysis and Design:​ Deeply understand factory business needs and processes (such as production planning, process routing, quality control, equipment management, etc.), and provide targeted application support, analysis, and design solutions.

System Integration and Testing:​ Coordinate the design, development, and testing of new applications and system interfaces (such as ERP and MES integration, equipment data collection).

Documentation Preparation and Review:​ Prepare, review, and approve relevant technical documents, including requirements analysis, system design, unit test plans, release notes, and user guides.

Requirements Gathering:​ Communicate with factory business departments (production, operations, quality, etc.) and internal/external customers to clarify system requirements and necessary functional improvements.

Cross-department Collaboration:​ Collaborate efficiently with other technical teams and business partners to drive project implementation.

Technology Innovation:​ Research, evaluate, and introduce new technologies to continuously optimize manufacturing system architecture and performance.

Requirements:

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

For Digital Hub Warsaw, we are looking for:

Senior Staff Geospatial Software Engineer

Build planet-scale geospatial data platforms that accelerate sustainable agriculture.

At Bayer Crop Science our mission is to develop agriculture solutions for a sustainable future that help meet the challenges of feeding a global population projected to grow to over 9.6 billion by 2050. This includes research and development of innovative modern agriculture solutions based on biotechnology and plant breeding, developing science based products including seeds and crop protection products, and modern analytics that help identify the best crop system for each acre.

To accomplish this mission we are capturing petabytes of data in our operational systems including everything from genome sequencing data, to manufacturing, supply chain and finance systems. This includes a tremendous volume of scientific data from field trials that requires complex analysis in order to extract meaningful information, and our mission is to understand that data and create software that will help make decisions at scales that has never been possible before.

Your tasks

  • Play a key senior role on a geospatial data engineering team, building distributed analytics capabilities and enabling enterprise-wide access to scientific and operational datasets.

  • Apply strong software craftsmanship with your knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and geospatial data models

  • Partner with other top-level talent in data engineering, software development, and data science to tackle complex, novel problems and deliver solutions with real-world impact on global food systems.

  • Mentor and guide other data engineers in your areas of expertise with a focus on geographic information science and systems.

  • Evaluate, implement, and advocate Foss4G technologies, finding the best fit for each use case and integrating them into production-ready solutions.

  • Lead technical initiatives end-to-end, communicate your technical vision and strategy to the larger organization.

  • Drive impact across enterprise projects spanning multiple areas of the business. Strength of ideas outweighs position in the organization

Who you are

  • 7+ experience as a software engineer

  • Proven experience in leading, mentoring and managing software development teams

  • A track record of shipping and maintaining multiple major product releases written in Go or Python

  • Extensive experience with observability practices for running and deploying software, including logging, metrics, tracing, and monitoring production systems to diagnose issues and ensure reliability

  • Experience with creating and maintaining containerized application deployments with a platform like Docker

  • Familiarity with developing in, deploying to, and working with Kubernetes cluster infrastructure

  • Expert understanding of software development lifecycle and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum)

  • Strong proficiency in software design and architecture

  • Extensive experience with version control systems like Git

  • Ability to write and oversee the development of clean, maintainable, and efficient code
    Proficiency with integrated development environments (IDEs) like Visual Studio, IntelliJ Idea or Eclipse

  • Strong knowledge of software development tools and practices, including continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD)

  • Advanced understanding of database management and SQL

  • Extensive experience with microservices architecture and RESTful API design

  • In-depth knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)

Preferred

title: Enterprise AI Product Lead
description:
Job Description

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life by providing life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, application and both measurement and asset management expertise.

The single point of contact for value, scope, and adoption across the pod's use case, and the pod's leader in practice. The Product Lead is the interface to the business sponsor and the person accountable for the use case landing in real workflows, operating two-in-a-box with the business domain lead. Expert-led AI is the operating principle: the domain experts frame the work, and the Product Lead ensures the pod builds what they framed rather than what was easiest to demo.

This is a high-autonomy role. The Product Lead operates a small senior team embedded far from the spine, owns a relationship with a VP-level sponsor, navigates the use case's RACI including Legal, Quality, and IT/Security dependencies where they sit on the critical path, and is expected to surface bad news early and kill criteria honestly. The role carries the pod's dual mandate personally: ship business value, and produce reusable Fabric assets, with neither traded away for the other.

Responsible for

  • Use case definition and KPI targets, agreed with the business sponsor at approval and tracked honestly through delivery; this includes owning the kill criteria written at approval and recommending a kill or pivot when the data says so.

  • Scope, sequencing, and the pod backlog: what gets built, in what order, and what explicitly does not, with trade-offs surfaced to the sponsor rather than absorbed silently.

  • Alignment across the pod and with the spine: the Product Lead is the dotted-line lead for the pod's engineers and the escalation path for dependencies on the data plane, the harness plane, and the cross-functional gates.

  • Stakeholder management for the use case's RACI, including the Legal and Quality gates on regulated use cases; the Product Lead keeps those gates moving by engaging them early, not by routing around them.

  • Adoption and value realization: intelligence shipped into the workflow, used by the named experts, with measured outcomes and adoption telemetry; not a demo that impressed a steering committee.

  • The pod's contribution to monthly portfolio review: honest status, measured value, named reusable assets, and what the spine needs to unblock.

What success looks like in year one

  • The pod's use case delivering against its committed KPI targets, with value measured in the sponsor's vocabulary and accepted by the sponsor, not only by the CoE.
  • Adoption demonstrated by named domain experts using the capability in their daily workflow, with telemetry that distinguishes real usage from launch-week curiosity.
  • At least one reusable Fabric asset from the pod named, certified, and consumed or queued for consumption by another use case.
  • A business sponsor who would fight to keep the pod, and a pod team that would follow this Product Lead to the next domain.
  • Primary owner of an enterprise AI solution responsible for managing the full solution lifecycle—from ideation and planning through development, deployment, and continuous iteration.
  • Acts as the central point for user experience, agile delivery, and cross-functional coordination across design, engineering, QA, and deployment teams
  • Defines and evolves product features based on user feedback, market research, and emerging technology trends.
  • Develops and maintains a product roadmap aligned with business goals and customer needs.
  • Partners with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure digital products are well positioned, adopted, and delivering measurable value.
  • May prepare product documentation, lead enablement efforts, and collaborate with technical teams to prioritize and deliver impactful digital enhancements.

Qualifications

title: IT Operational Analyst
description:
Bridge Technology and Business Impact as an IT Operational Analyst

Are you a problem-solver who enjoys connecting business needs with innovative technology solutions? Liberty Dental Plan is looking for an IT Operational Analyst who can identify opportunities for improvement, collaborate across teams, and help drive the continuous enhancement of critical business systems and processes.

About the Role

The IT Operational Analyst serves as a vital link between business stakeholders and IT teams, ensuring technology solutions align with operational goals and business requirements. This role focuses on analyzing system performance, identifying technical deficiencies, gathering and documenting requirements, and supporting the implementation of solutions that improve efficiency and business outcomes.

If you're passionate about process improvement, business analysis, technology operations, and cross-functional collaboration, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization.

What You'll Do

Business & IT Partnership

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business units and IT teams.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements and actionable solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring alignment between technology initiatives and business objectives.
  • Provide regular updates on project progress, system enhancements, and issue resolution efforts.

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

  • Work closely with stakeholders to gather, document, and validate business requirements.
  • Analyze existing systems and processes to identify performance gaps, technical deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for requirements, process changes, and implemented solutions.

Solution Development & Operational Support

  • Partner with IT teams to design and implement solutions that improve system functionality and performance.
  • Support the diagnosis and resolution of technical issues to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Apply knowledge of Robotic Process Automation (RPA), APIs, and web applications when troubleshooting and implementing technology solutions.
  • Monitor ongoing system effectiveness and recommend improvements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to optimize IT systems and business processes.
  • Support technology initiatives that improve operational efficiency, user experience, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in an IT operational role with a focus on business analysis and systems improvement.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify, evaluate, and resolve technical issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a dynamic environment.

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Knowledge of data analysis, SQL, and reporting tools.
  • Experience with business analysis methodologies, process modeling, and IT troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of IT systems, operational processes, and systems improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), API integrations, and web-based applications.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.

Success Factors

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Comfortable navigating complex challenges with limited standardization.
  • Detail-oriented with a passion for process improvement and operational excellence.

Career Growth Opportunities

Liberty Dental Plan's IT Operational Analyst career path offers opportunities for advancement based on experience and expertise:

  • Associate IT Operational Analyst: Entry-level support and operational responsibilities.
  • IT Operational Analyst: Independent contributor serving as a liaison between business and IT teams.
  • Senior IT Operational Analyst: Leads complex projects and mentors team members.
  • Principal IT Operational Analyst: Provides strategic leadership, enterprise-level expertise, and consultation to senior stakeholders.

Why Join Liberty Dental Plan?

At Liberty Dental Plan, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside talented professionals dedicated to improving business operations through technology. You'll contribute to meaningful projects, gain exposure to cross-functional initiatives, and play a key role in helping the organization deliver innovative and effective solutions.

If you're ready to leverage your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and collaborative approach to drive business success, we encourage you to apply.

Apply today and help shape the future of operational excellence through technology at Liberty Dental Plan.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Location: London
Department: PR, Social & Influence
Reporting Into: Group Head of Strategy
Full Time / Part Time: Full Time
Contract Type: 12-month Fixed Term Contract



About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity at Ogilvy to play a pivotal role in elevating our social capabilities for 2026, helping us redefine our social and content offer and realize our new global ambition of ‘building social brands’.

Ogilvy is seeking an experienced Social Strategy Director, responsible for setting the standard for social-first strategic thinking within the agency and exciting our high-profile clients about the opportunities of social. The ideal candidate is relentlessly curious about social, deeply immersed in culture, trends and conversation, and a thought leader who can challenge traditional thinking. Collaborating closely with clients, you'll gain a deep understanding of their businesses, target audiences, and brand values, translating this knowledge to develop inventive strategic solutions tailored to meet each client’s distinct objectives, to secure social buy-in and drive tangible outcomes. Your experience will span socially led campaigns as well as always on organic social and editorial thinking.

As a mentor and leader, you'll guide and support junior team members in their professional growth, fostering an environment of collaboration and agility. You’ll advocate for diversity of thought and champion inclusive approaches. Your ability to lead, inspire, and collaborate with others will be integral to thriving in this ever-evolving industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy leadership: Lead the development of best-in-class social strategies that are firmly rooted in clients’ overall business and brand objectives, incorporating the latest trends and best practices. Drive demand for the strategy department's services internally and externally (part of this will be through the consistent delivery of the teams’ exceptional strategic work).

  • Client relationship management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to deeply understand their business, target audience and brand ethos, and formulate campaigns that resonate and yield results. Quickly and intuitively uncover client business challenges, mine for unique insights, and develop innovative social and content strategies that uniquely solve those challenges in social and build their brand.
  • Team leadership & collaboration: Line manage a team of brilliant strategists and foster collaboration, curiosity and best-in-class delivery of strategy. Mentor the team through the development of their strategies, providing feedback and counsel. Offer mentorship and guidance to junior team members, cultivating their skills and fostering career growth. Partner with internal teams—creative, account, and media—to ensure campaign integration aligns with overall brand strategy. Craft briefs that distil that strategic thinking into clear direction for creative teams.

  • Thought leadership & industry influence: Emerge as a thought leader both within the agency and the industry at large, sharing insights, trends, and best practices with teams and clients. This may involve contributing to group-level thought leadership as well as championing social-first thinking within the agency. Push traditional thinking and develop unique social narratives. Stay abreast of industry trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies to establish yourself to senior clients and agency colleagues as a thought leader in social.

  • Social excellence & innovation: Support the Social Excellence Lead by contributing to the ideation, development and implementation of game-changing social initiatives. Think laterally about how to uncover unique insights by working closely with our in-house Marketing Science partners to test hypotheses. Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and tools in influence and social marketing, applying and scaling this knowledge to clients to enhance campaign performance.

  • New business & pitch support: Contribute to new business pitches and proposals, infusing creative and strategic ideas to differentiate Ogilvy (this will be on an ad-hoc basis and dependant on resource).

About You

We are open minded as to your background, and to whether you are a creative, strategist, creator or a blend of all of those things. You might even be a two-person team and we are open to that too. You don’t need to have worked in a big network agency and we are not expecting you to have run a big team, but we are looking for an entrepreneurial spirit and someone who can seek out opportunities to make brilliant, stand-out work that drives fame for our clients and us. You will bring some great experience with brands and some of those would ideally be multi-national clients. Here’s some characteristics we’ll be looking for:

  • Enthusiasm. This is first because it is the most important. We want people who radiate energy about the work and the impact they can have on it.
  • Our values are – Do the Right Thing, Do the Best Work of Our Lives, Do it Together. If all of those speak to you, you’ll love it here.
  • Innovation. Social is a space of constant change, experimentation is a huge part of how we get better and we’d love you to be bold about innovating and trying new things
  • Collaboratio We want to hear about how you have succeeded with team-mates, clients, creators etc as much if not more so than what you have achieved alone.
  • Cultural intelligence and inclusivity. You are culturally intelligent, champion diversity, and an inclusive culture and are supportive, inspiring and inclusive in the way you work and in the work that you produce.

How we help you Thrive

  • 25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day
  • Bupa Healthcare
  • Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave
  • We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm

  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance

Ogilvy champions innovation and the thoughtful application of AI. We encourage you to use AI tools to enhance your application and achieve the best possible results. During interviews, we may explore how you leverage AI, showcasing your judgment and ability to integrate these technologies effectively.

Please ensure your application authentically reflects your own skills, experience, and unique contributions.

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.





Job Description

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Acts as a resource to work groups and project teams, within the plant and outside the plant relative to quality and regulatory issues.

  • Leads or participates on Kaizen teams to improve quality and reduce waste.

  • Investigates and provides engineering solutions to quality related manufacturing issues.

  • Maintains familiarity with manufacturing processes and products to evaluate the cause and effect of defects and identify trends in process and product quality.

  • Provides technical input for projects using the application of FMEA’s, risk mitigation, plant validations; DOE’s’ and other experiments and investigations as assigned.

  • Lead projects using the application of continuous improvement tools and methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean, etc.

  • Works with all departments to maintain the highest quality standards.

  • Formulates, reviews and implements policies and procedures relating to product quality and process control as appropriate.

  • Ensures that all activities comply with government (OSHA, EPA, FDA, ISO, etc.) regulations and corresponding company policies/procedures including activities and programs as defined in the Quality Systems Manual for BD Broken Bow.

  • Coordinates machine and process capability studies, analyzes the data and submits recommendations.

  • Designs and assists Production, Engineering and Division in the completion of new product/process evaluations including Hazard Analysis.

  • Coordinates communication between Division R&D and Plant personnel on new products, product improvements and product issues.

  • Participates in Engineering and Production functions as required to achieve the overall objectives of the Plant.

  • Performs other duties as assigned, such as Internal Audits, PIR/CFI investigations. Supports plant safety initiatives

Minimum Requirements:

  • BA/BS Degree in Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Medical device manufacturing experience preferred.

  • Preferred 1-2 years of relevant experience; however, internships, co-op experience, and relevant engineering projects will also be considered.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

  • Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to support a variety of day-to-day responsibilities.

    Why Join Us?

    To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

title: Ophthalmologists wanted for private clinics in Ireland
description:
Are you an ophthalmologist looking to combine professional development with international experience in an English-speaking healthcare system?

On behalf of private clinics across Ireland, we are recruiting ophthalmologists across all subspecialties for positions lasting 12 or 24 months, with the possibility of extension. This is an opportunity to work in a modern clinical setting while broadening your expertise and gaining international experience.

Whether your background is in a specific subspecialty or general ophthalmology, you will become part of a collaborative clinical environment within private practice, with a strong focus on quality of care and professional development.

About the position

As an ophthalmologist, you will be involved in the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of patients with a wide range of eye conditions. Depending on your background and the needs of the department, your role may include both outpatient and surgical work.

We are looking for specialists within all areas of ophthalmology, including but not limited to:

  • Retina (medical and surgical)
  • Glaucoma
  • Cornea and anterior segment
  • Cataract and refractive surgery
  • Pediatric ophthalmology and strabismus
  • Neuro-ophthalmology
  • Oculoplastic and orbital surgery
  • General ophthalmology

You will work closely with other specialists, nurses and healthcare professionals in a multidisciplinary setting.

Typical responsibilities

  • Assessment, diagnosis and treatment of patients with ophthalmic conditions
  • Performing surgical procedures relevant to your subspecialty
  • Outpatient consultations and follow-up of patients
  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams
  • Supervision and mentoring of junior doctors where relevant
  • Contribution to quality improvement and clinical development within the department
  • Participation in on-call duties if required

We are looking for candidates who

  • Are specialists in ophthalmology
  • Hold medical authorisation and specialist recognition from an EU/EEA country
  • Have experience in one or more ophthalmology subspecialties (or general ophthalmology)
  • Have an interest in working in a new healthcare system
  • Have good English language skills, both spoken and written
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with patients and colleagues
  • Thrive in a professional and collaborative environment

We offer

  • Contract for 12 or 24 months, with the possibility of extension
  • The opportunity to gain international experience in an English-speaking healthcare system
  • Professional development within a highly specialised clinical field
  • Close follow-up and guidance throughout the entire recruitment process
  • Assistance with registration, interviews and relocation
  • The opportunity for a short visit to Ireland, ideally together with your partner or family, to get to know the hospital and the area before making a decision

Salary

Starting salary from approximately €150,000 gross per year, with the potential for higher earnings depending on patient lists and activity level.

Why Ireland?

Working in Ireland gives you the opportunity to practice medicine in an English-speaking healthcare system while gaining valuable international experience. You will work in a collaborative clinical environment with modern facilities and a strong focus on patient care.

Beyond work, Ireland offers a high quality of life and a welcoming atmosphere. The country is known for its dramatic coastline, green landscapes and charming towns. Ireland also has a lively social culture, where local pubs often serve as gathering places for music, conversation and community.

Interested?

We would be happy to tell you more about the opportunities, possible locations, and the next steps in the process. Feel free to contact us for an informal conversation.

title: Process Engineer
description:

TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

title: Global Head of Operational Services
description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

Role Overview

The Global Head of Operational Services is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, operational performance and transformation of TP ICAP's global Client Lifecycle Management (CLM) and Party Reference Data functions.

The role is accountable for ensuring the effective onboarding, maintenance and offboarding of clients, counterparties and related entities across the Group, while maintaining the integrity, quality and governance of Party Reference Data used throughout TP ICAP's front-to-back ecosystem.

The role will lead globally distributed teams across EMEA, Americas and APAC and will be responsible for delivering operational excellence, regulatory compliance, client experience, risk reduction and strategic transformation initiatives. The role forms part of the Global Operations Leadership Team and will work closely with Compliance, Risk, Technology, Legal, Finance, Data Management and Front Office stakeholders.

Role Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead and develop the global Operational Services function across all regions.

  • Define and execute the strategic direction for Client Lifecycle Management and Reference Data operations.

  • Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client service excellence.

  • Contribute to the wider Global Operations strategy and transformation agenda.

  • Lead annual planning, budget and resource management activities for the function. Responsibilities for strategic planning, operational efficiency, governance and resource management align with TP ICAP leadership role expectations.


Client Lifecycle Management

  • Ensure the effective delivery of operational services in line with agreed service levels, regulatory requirements, and business expectations.

  • Maintain oversight of the end-to-end client lifecycle, including onboarding, periodic reviews, offboarding, and associated regulatory controls.

  • Oversee Reference Data management activities, ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and maintenance of critical business data.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for Operational Services matters globally.

  • Establish a globally consistent governance framework for client lifecycle activities

Risk, Control & Governance

  • Maintain a strong operational risk and control framework, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations, policies, and internal standards.

  • Lead engagement with Internal Audit, Risk, Compliance, and other control functions.

  • Ensure operational activities align with the firm's risk management framework and governance requirements.

  • Establish and lead governance forums to drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement across the function.

Data Governance

  • Act as Data Steward for Operational Services within the firm's Data Governance framework.

  • Champion data quality, ownership, and governance standards across Operational Services.

  • Ensure operational data is managed, controlled, and maintained in accordance with enterprise data policies.

Change & Transformation

  • Identify and deliver opportunities to improve operational efficiency, control effectiveness, and service quality.

  • Partner with Technology and Change teams to support system enhancements, platform migrations, automation initiatives, and operational transformation projects.

  • Ensure appropriate testing and implementation governance is applied to system and process changes.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong partnerships with Front Office, Compliance, Technology, Operations, Risk, and other key stakeholders.

  • Provide timely management information, insights, and reporting to senior leadership.

  • Represent Operational Services in strategic initiatives, projects, and governance forums.

People Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and mentor regional managers and global teams.

  • Drive talent development, succession planning, performance management, and employee engagement.

  • Ensure appropriate organisational structure, resourcing, and capability to meet current and future business needs.

  • Foster a collaborative global operating model that promotes knowledge sharing and operational resilience.

Experience / Competences

Essential

  • Significant leadership experience within Operations in a wholesale financial markets, capital markets, banking, or financial services environment.

  • Deep and demonstrated understanding of Client Lifecycle Management, KYC/AML processes, and operational controls.

  • Experience leading large, geographically dispersed teams and driving organisational change.

  • Proven ability to design and improve operational processes, controls, and service delivery models.

  • Proven and robust stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior business leaders and control functions.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

  • Experience interacting with regulators, auditors and senior executive stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated experience managing risk, governance, and regulatory obligations within an operational environment.

Desirable

  • Deep knowledge of wholesale financial markets and post-trade operational processes.

  • Experience leading data governance, data quality, or reference data initiatives.

  • Experience delivering technology-enabled transformation, automation, or operating model change.

  • Proven track record of driving continuous improvement and operational excellence programmes.

Job Band & Level

  • Function Head / 9

#LI-DIR #LI-Hybrid

Not The Perfect Fit?

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. title: Head of Creative at AIOS — Remote, $150,000–$250,000/yr + 0.10%–0.30% equity
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.
We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being the Head of Creative at Aios

We are building a world-class team.

As Head of Creative at Aios, your fundamental role is to own creative — setting the direction, quality bar, and ideation system that drives performance at $1M+/month Meta spend (+ fast-scaling Google spends).

You'll take our ad creative to best in category, closing the gap in emotional resonance and visual quality that currently caps our CAC efficiency.

You'll lead and develop our in-house creative team of five (and growing), anchoring everything in performance data and a distinctive creative point of view for our largest brand, Bolt Pharmacy in the UK.

You will then build the creative localisation playbook for Germany and the Netherlands as we blitzscale into Europe later this year. You'll extend the creative flywheel to TV and other social channels as those channels develop.

You'll achieve this by building an AI-driven repeatable creative system: brief to production to performance loop, 300+ distinct concepts per sprint, and a testing roadmap that keeps media buying ahead of saturation.

You'll be a key driver of all Brand asset refreshes, helping set the creative direction and making sure the new identity lands across every customer touchpoint.

Great performance in this role means creative is our sharpest growth lever and competitive advantage. The performance team has a constant pipeline of conceptually distinct, emotionally resonant creative to test. Our ads stop people in their feed, create a strong emotional connection, and improve the effectiveness of every incremental dollar we spend.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work async in the timezone of your choice - as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time for calls as needed.

You'll report directly to Dave Lane (Head of Performance).

You'll also work most closely with:

  • André Andrade (Creative Lead)

  • Michael McCann (Head of CRO)

  • Our in-house Creative Team (Brazil-based)

Key responsibilities

  • Creative Strategy: Set the creative direction for all creative, primarily Meta ($1M+/month), anchored in performance data. You are the taste-maker.

  • Raise Creative Quality: Close the 8→10/10 gap in the UK. The gap is emotional resonance and visual quality. Create differentiated, non-formulaic ads that reduce our CAC. Set the bar and hold it across everything we put in market.

  • EU Creative Expansion: Build the creative localisation playbook for Germany, the Netherlands, and other local markets. Create market-native work that reflects local psychology, platform behaviour, and cultural nuance.

  • Own the Ideation Pipeline: Every brief must pass the distinctiveness test: would Meta's algorithm treat this as a genuinely new concept?

  • Build the AI Creative System: Elevate the existing AI-assisted production stack, from brief to production to iteration, with tight feedback loops between creative output and performance data.

  • Bolt Brand Visual Refresh: Lead the Bolt brand visual refresh, ensuring the new identity is consistent and lands across every customer touchpoint.

  • Test & Scale: Lead high-velocity experiments across hooks, formats, angles, and messaging. Scale winners aggressively. Inform future channel creative, including CTV and linear TV, as those tests develop.

  • Partner with Performance: Work hand-in-glove with Dave, our Head of Performance, and the growing media buying team. Connect creative output directly to CAC and ROAS. The goal is subscription-first creative at 300+ distinct concepts per sprint.

  • Oversee TV Creative: Oversee the development of best-in-class DRTV and performance creative for our first forays into the channel.

  • Lead the Creative Team: Manage and develop a small but high-impact team. Andre shifts towards production operations and AI workflows; you shift the team from execution to creative excellence.

Need to have

  • Performance creative at scale: 5+ years leading performance creative for DTC brands running £500k+/month in adspend on Meta. You have seen what works at scale, what breaks, and what separates a good creative account from a great one.

  • Concept, brief, direct: You are a creative, not just a creative manager. You can generate concepts, write briefs that unlock the team, and give direction that raises the ceiling. You get in the weeds to lead your team.

  • Emotional creative instinct: You know why some ads make people feel something and others do not. You can articulate emotional hooks, human truth, and brand voice, and direct a team toward it.

  • Brand and visual quality: You have strong visual sensibility and aesthetic standards. You can elevate the quality of what the team produces without losing performance.

  • Team leadership: You have managed creative teams at real scale and developed talent above where you found it. Junior creatives grow into senior creatives under you.

  • Systems thinking: You build repeatable systems for ideation, briefing, and production. You do not rely on hero moments to hit volume.

  • Data fluency: You read creative performance data fluently (Meta reporting, iteration mapping, hook rate, hold rate, CTR to CVR) and use it to inform decisions, not to justify them.

  • AI creative tooling fluency: You have a demonstrated history of using AI to multiply creative output, not to replace craft. You know which AI tools work today, which do not, and where the frontier is moving.

  • Structured operator behaviors: Forecasting output, weekly reporting cadence, explicit decision rules, written planning. You are not just a great creative. You are someone the team can rely on. Your work is legible.

  • Startup intensity: 50+ hours a week, async, in a high-ownership culture. Outcomes over hours, but the outcomes here require real intensity.

Nice to have

  • Agentic: You're a doer. You’ve been pulled into important problems, taken risks, excelled in new areas.

  • Brand identity project experience: You have led or been the senior voice on a brand refresh, rebrand, or visual identity evolution.

  • EU multi-market creative: Direct experience directing creative across multiple European markets, particularly Germany and/or Netherlands.

  • Regulated category experience: Health, wellness, GLP-1, telehealth, or any category where ASA / CAP / GPhC compliance shapes the creative every day.

  • Broadcast and long-form video: CTV, DR TV, Linear TV, or YouTube long-form video creative experience.

  • Cross-channel paid social: Direct experience running creative on TikTok, YouTube shorts, Snap, or other paid social platforms beyond Meta.

  • Landing page collaboration: You have worked closely with CRO or product teams on the ad-to-LP handoff and understand where creative ends and LP begins.

  • Founder-adjacent mindset: You have founded something in the past (however small), or you plan to. You have taken risks, been pulled into important problems, and excelled in unfamiliar territory.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

title: Research Scientist IV
description:
Job Title: Research Scientist IV

Grade: 27

Salary: $105,922-$126,392

The Research Foundation for Mental Hygiene is seeking a qualified candidate to fill a full-time Research Scientist IV position. This position involves leading a research team in a pre-clinical project that is federally funded. The goal of the research project is to identify, at the neural circuit level, the sustained changes caused by early life stress that induce reward-deficits later in life. The specific aims of the project are:

  • To determine if produces deficits in the activity of distinct populations of cells in the ventral pallidum (VP)
  • To examine if early life stress disrupts VP-Nac afferent activity during hedonic encoding.
  • To test if the VP to Nac projections mediate the early life stress induced hedonic deficits.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • The candidate will lead a small team of researchers including 1 full-time technician and 3-4 undergraduate research assistants.
  • They will be responsible for training the team members and supervising their daily work.
  • Specifically, the candidate will train the technician and students in all methods of data collection and analysis. this will include (not limited to), stereotaxic surgery, mouse husbandry, in vivo e-Phys recordings, behavioral testing, data analysis.
  • The candidate will be responsible for data management, interpreting the results and preparing them for publication.
  • The candidate will also be responsible for ensuring that all experiments are conducted according to federal state, city, university and NYSPI regulations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and (5) years of professional research experience in an appropriate field or master's degree in an appropriate field may substitute for (1) year of experience, or Ph.D. in an appropriate field may substitute for an additional year of experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in neuroscience or related area of biology.
  • A minimum of 5 years of postdoctoral experience and a minimum of 5 years working with rodent models of neuropsychiatric conditions.
  • At least in 5 years of experience with rodent models of stress in defined developmental periods.
  • At least in 5 years of experimental and analytic methods of in vivo electrophysiology.

Ljung & Sjöberg grundades ur personliga erfarenheter och en gemensam insikt att många chefer står ensamma i svåra situationer, utan rätt stöd för att agera. Det blev startpunkten för vårt arbete - att ge arbetsgivare kunskap, mod och struktur för att kunna hantera beroendeproblematik på att omtänksamt och effektivt sätt.

Drogtester genomförs alla dagar i veckan och på alla tider av dygnet.

Du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt och är utåtriktad. Det är viktigt att du är strukturerad, effektiv och stresstålig. Du är van att hantera människor, är trygg och tydlig i din kommunikation. Integritet är ett ledord för dig.

title: Field Service Engineer 3
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

As a Field Service Engineer at Lam, you will step into the limelight of customer support. Your work goes beyond installations and troubleshooting; it ensures the operational excellence of our complex semiconductor equipment. You're on the front lines, understanding customer needs and collaborating with various teams to deliver solutions.

What you’ll do

  • Provide quality on-site repair, maintenance service, and complete installation/relocation start-up services of Lam’s complex electro-mechanical and electronic systems at customer sites.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, or related field and 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years; or equivalent work experience.
  • Previous experience in installation, maintenance, repair, or troubleshooting of semiconductor capital equipment.
  • Proficiency in interpreting electrical and mechanical schematics, diagrams, and operation manuals.
  • Able to work in a clean room environment while wearing personal protective safety equipment, or cleanroom suit.
  • Frequently position oneself (e.g., bend, stoop, reach, walk, sit, twist, squat, kneel, climb, stand) to perform job tasks for extended periods.

Preferred qualifications

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role.
