title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will be a key player in developing our product, while ensuring our infrastructure and application meet the highest security standards. You'll lead the development of full stack features, mentor junior developers, and take ownership of our application — from implementing new features to planning architectural decisions.

You will work with our engineering team at our headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, collaborating closely with both the product development and operations teams.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about building robust, secure systems at scale — managing one of the industry's largest geospatial image datasets, rendering complex 2D and 3D map data, and designing architecture that balances functionality with reliability. You'll contribute to both production engineering and R&D initiatives, helping us maintain trust with our customers while scaling our platform to meet growing demand.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and deliver full stack features for our web application (React frontend) and server-side API (Python backend)
  • Design and implement features across our AWS infrastructure and application layers
  • Plan and evaluate architecture for scalable and reliable infrastructure of a global product
  • Mentor developers in code quality, structure and other best practices
  • Collaborate with the CTO and VP of Engineering to define and improve the product and architecture.
  • Build and maintain geospatial UI systems with interactive 2D and 3D components using React and different map APIs


About You‍

You have:

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a track record of overcoming complex programming challenges
  • Extensive expertise in:
  • Backend development
  • SQL/Postgres
  • Experience with:
  • React
  • AWS, GCP or similar
  • Skill for debating tradeoffs for software design decisions, particularly around security and performance
  • Mentorship experience for developers
  • Degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent experience
  • Excellent written and spoken English


It’s an advantage if you also have:

  • Knowledge of IaC and Terraform
  • Worked with web test automation (Playwright)

‍

Why Arkion‍

  • Impact that matters: your work directly contributes to power grid reliability and supports the energy transition in the society.
  • Real ownership: you’ll shape and influence both product features and system architecture as we scale.
  • Strong and supportive team: you’ll work alongside motivated, collaborative, international colleagues with deep domain and technical expertise.
  • Modern tech-stack: we build AI for power-grid assessment for our customers, and we continuously use and evaluate AI tools built by others to boost our own efficiency; our infrastructure is set up in Terraform and we have a high degree of test automation.
  • Flexible work environment: our company culture accommodates different life circumstances and personal needs.


Practicalities

  • Full-time, permanent position located in Stockholm, Sweden.
  • Working hours: Full-time (40 hours/week).
  • Expected start date: as soon as possible, or by agreement.
  • Salary: Competitive salary based on experience.


How to apply:

Email your CV to arbetsformedlingen@arkion.co with the subject line Senior Fullstack Engineer. A brief note on your motivation for applying is appreciated.

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:

  • Integration Expertise: Proven track record in MM integration with FI/CO, SD, PP/WM, and external procurement tools.

  • Language: Professional working proficiency in English.

title: Core Banking Specialist
description:
The initial training for this role will take place in Independence and may require up to a year to complete the training period. After training completion, this role may be flexible with branch location.

Position Summary

The Core Banking Specialist I supports day-to-day administration, maintenance, data quality, system integration support, system security support, core user access setup, user support, and change adoption functions for BankIowa's core banking environment. This role assists with product and parameter updates, integration support, controlled testing, documentation, report requests, team member support, and Intranet backup responsibilities. The position is expected to be a positive champion of change by helping team members understand improvements, adopt new processes, and maintain accurate, reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

Key Responsibilities

Core System Support, Integrations, Security & Maintenance

  • Assist with routine maintenance of core banking products, services, parameters, and customer or account-related settings under established procedures and approvals.
  • Support system accuracy by reviewing data, identifying inconsistencies, and helping resolve data quality issues.
  • Assist with core release preparation, validation, post-implementation review, and documentation activities.
  • Support system integrations by helping validate data flow, configuration requirements, connectivity changes, and business-line readiness.
  • Assist with core system security and user access setup, including new user setup, role-based access changes, access reviews, and approval documentation.

User Support, Training & Documentation

  • Provide timely support to team members across business lines for core-related questions, troubleshooting, and process guidance.
  • Create and maintain practical procedures, quick reference materials, and training aids for end users and frontline trainers.
  • Support the train-the-trainer model by preparing materials and assisting with team member training as requested.
  • Communicate core changes and process updates in a clear, business-friendly manner that promotes understanding, confidence, and positive adoption.

Testing, Reporting, Intranet Backup & Change Support

  • Assist with testing, user acceptance validation, and documentation for core system changes, enhancements, and product updates.
  • Prepare or assist with routine reports and data extracts for business areas, audits, reviews, and operational analysis.
  • Serve as backup to the Core Banking Specialist II for BankIowa Intranet updates, maintenance, content accuracy, clean data, and approved purge or cleanup activities.
  • Follow BankIowa change management practices, including documentation, approvals, validation, and controlled rollout support.
  • Escalate issues, risks, or exceptions to the Senior Core Banking Manager or appropriate system owner.

Governance, Compliance & Collaboration

  • Follow BankIowa policies, procedures, information security standards, and applicable state and federal banking requirements.
  • Protect confidential customer, team member, and bank information and follow established access control practices.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with Operations, Digital Banking, Consumer Banking, Business Banking, Finance, Risk/Compliance, IT, and other business partners.
  • Complete annual compliance training, including Bank Secrecy Act, OFAC, CIP, privacy, and information security training applicable to the role.

Qualifications

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, information systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent banking or systems experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of banking products, account processing, deposit operations, loan operations, or core banking systems preferred.
  • Comfort learning technology systems, Intranet content standards, system integrations, system security concepts, user access setup, procedures, reporting tools, and system maintenance processes.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, documentation discipline, and follow-through.
  • Ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and communicate clearly with team members at all levels of the organization.
  • Commitment to confidentiality, information security, compliance, and service excellence.

Core Competencies

  • Customer and team member service focus
  • Positive change champion mindset
  • Data accuracy, access control awareness, and process discipline
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Problem solving and sound judgment
  • Collaboration across departments and locations
  • Adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to learn

Success Measures

  • Timely and accurate completion of assigned maintenance, reporting, user access, integration support, backup Intranet, and support tasks.
  • Effective documentation of procedures, testing, and changing support activities.
  • Positive internal service feedback and timely issue escalation.
  • Demonstrated understanding of BankIowa compliance, information security, and data governance expectations.
  • Successful completion of required annual training.

Physical Environment:

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Performance of the job will include physical duties commensurate with a general office environment.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to ten pounds.

title: S-Päällikkövalmennus, Osuuskauppa Varuboden-Osla / Utbildningsprogrammet S-Chef, Handelslaget Varuboden-Osla
description:
Primary location:

VANTAA

Haemme S-Päällikkövalmennettavia Osuuskauppa Varuboden-Oslaan!

Etsimme motivoituneita ja tavoitteellisia tulevaisuuden esihenkilöitä mukaan S-Päällikkövalmennukseen, joka tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden kasvaa kaupan, ravintola-alan tai liikennekaupan päällikkötehtäviin.

Marraskuussa 2026 alkava S-Päällikkövalmennus on noin 1,5 vuotta kestävä palkallinen valmennusohjelma, jossa yhdistyvät käytännön työssä oppiminen, verkko- ja lähikoulutukset sekä henkilökohtainen ohjaus. Valmennuksen aikana syvennät toimialaosaamistasi, kehität johtamisvalmiuksiasi ja verkostoidut muiden S-ryhmän valmennettavien kanssa. Valmennuksen tavoitteena on antaa sinulle vahvat valmiudet toimia esihenkilö- ja vastuutehtävissä. Lue lisää S-Päällikkövalmennuksesta.

Toimipaikkamme sijaitsevat alueella Loviisasta Sipooseen, Kauniaisissa ja Kirkkonummelta Hankoon sekä Ahvenanmaalla. Hakuvaiheessa pääset kertomaan, mikä toimiala ja alue kiinnostavat sinua eniten. Valmennuksen jälkeen voit työllistyä esimerkiksi vuoro-, apulais-, market-, ravintola- tai liikennemyymäläpäällikön tehtäviin.

Tämä voisi olla juuri sinulle, jos

- Olet suorittanut AMK-tutkinnon, olet valmistumassa tai sinulla on ammatillinen tutkinto sekä jo jonkin verran alan työkokemusta.

- Olet utelias, innokas ja oma-aloitteinen.

- Olet tuloshakuinen ja omaat organisointi- ja paineensietokykyä.

- Haluat työskennellä ihmisten kanssa esimerkkiä näyttäen.

- Sinulla on aitoa paloa asiakaspalveluun ja esihenkilötyöhön.

Molempien kotimaisten kielten hallinta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta työssä myös oppii!

Tarjoamme sinulle

- Mielenkiintoisen mahdollisuuden kehittyä huippuporukassa. Pääset laaja-alaisesti kasvattamaan osaamistasi ja ammattitaitoasi esihenkilönä ja syventämään osaamistasi omalla toimialallasi.

- Henkilökohtaisen tutorin, joka on tukenasi valmennuspolkusi ajan.

- Liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut.

- Suomen parhaat henkilökuntaedut, joita pääset käyttämään ympäri Suomen, S-ryhmän ja yhteistyökumppaneiden toimipisteissä.

- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen tulospalkkioon koko yrityksen tuloksen perusteella (jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti / vuosi).

- Vakituisen, kokoaikaisen työsuhteen.

- Palkkaa valmennusohjelman ajalta noin 2 700 €/kk.

Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 30.8.2026. Lisätietoja antaa henkilöstöjohtaja Paula Pajunen sähköpostilla (paula.pajunen@sok.). Paulan tavoittaa puhelimitse tiistaina 11.8. klo 14.00-15.00 tai torstaina 27.8. klo 13.30-14.30.

***

Vi söker deltagare till utbildningsprogrammet S-Chef på Varuboden-Osla

Vi söker motiverade och målinriktade framtida chefer till S-Chefsutbildningen, som erbjuder en utmärkt möjlighet att växa in i chefsuppgifter inom handeln, restaurangbranschen eller trafikhandeln.

S-Chefsutbildningen, som börjar i november 2026, är ett avlönat utbildningsprogram som pågår i cirka 1,5 år och kombinerar praktiskt lärande i arbetet, webb- och närundervisning samt personlig handledning. Under utbildningen fördjupar du din branschkompetens, utvecklar dina ledarskapsfärdigheter och skapar nätverk med andra deltagare inom S-gruppen. Målet med utbildningen är att ge dig starka färdigheter för att arbeta i chefs- och ansvarsuppgifter. Läs mer om S-Chefsutbildningen (på finska).

Våra enheter finns i området från Lovisa till Sibbo, i Grankulla och från Kyrkslätt till Hangö samt på Åland. I ansökningsskedet får du berätta vilken bransch och vilket område som intresserar dig mest. Efter utbildningen kan du till exempel få arbete som skiftchef, biträdande chef, marketchef, restaurangchef eller trafikbutikschef.

Det här kan passa just dig om du

- har avlagt en yrkeshögskoleexamen, håller på att utexamineras eller har en yrkesexamen samt redan viss arbetserfarenhet inom branschen

- är nyfiken, energisk och initiativrik

- är resultatinriktad, har god organisationsförmåga och är stresstålig

- vill jobba med mänskor och föregå med exempel

- har en genuin passion för kundservice och chefsarbete

Kunskaper i båda inhemska språken ses som en fördel, men du lär dig också på jobbet!

Vi erbjuder dig

- en intressant möjlighet att utvecklas i ett toppengäng. Du får bredda din kompetens och yrkesskicklighet som chef och fördjupa ditt kunnande inom din egen bransch

- en egen tutor som stödjer dig under hela din utbildning

- idrotts-, kultur- och välmåendeförmåner.

- Finlands bästa personalförmåner som du kan utnyttja runtom i Finland i S-gruppens och våra samarbetspartners enheter

- möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie baserat på företagets resultat (upp till 1,70 €/arbetstimme/år)

- en tillsvidareanställning på heltid

- en lön på cirka 2 700 euro/månad under utbildningsprogrammet.

Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 30.8.2026. Mer information får du av personaldirektör Paula Pajunen per e-post (paula.pajunen@sok.). Paula kan nås per telefon tisdag 11.8 kl. 14.00–15.00 eller torsdag 27.8 kl. 13.30–14.30.

title: IT Project Manager
description:
Join us as an IT Project Manager

Join us as an IT Project Manager in Porto and play a key role in delivering one of Europe's most ambitious post-trade transformation programmes.

As part of Euronext Securities, you will help build the infrastructure backbone of Europe's integrated capital markets. Working in an advanced technological environment, you will collaborate with international teams to modernise our post-trade platform and deliver a single, integrated hub serving multiple Central Securities Depositories (CSDs).

Reporting to the Head of IT PM, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic IT projects, collaborating closely with business and technology teams across Italy, Portugal, Denmark, and Norway to ensure successful delivery and alignment across Euronext Securities.

Why Join This Role

  • Contribute to the transformation of European financial market infrastructure.
  • Work on large-scale, business-critical initiatives in a highly regulated environment.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Europe.
  • Be part of an organisation where innovation and AI are key enablers of productivity and delivery excellence.

What You Bring

  • At least ten years of IT project management experience in financial services, preferably within post-trade, securities, or capital markets.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex organisational environments.
  • Familiarity with CSD operations, settlement infrastructure, or post-trade regulation (CSDR, T2S) is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; additional European languages are an asset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support project activities from the earliest stages, coordinating pre-assessments, including high-level requirements gathering, impact analysis, solution design, planning, and effort estimation.
  • Analyse and prioritise initiatives and change requests in line with programme and portfolio objectives.
  • Coordinate project scope, detailed planning, solution design, and effort estimation throughout the execution phase.
  • Manage project plans, dependencies, risks, issues, scope, and change requests while providing regular project status reporting.
  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment across the overall portfolio of initiatives.
  • Support the successful transition of projects into Business-as-Usual (BAU).

Required Skills

  • Experience delivering IT projects in complex environments.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to document complex assumptions, risks, and commitments.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary and cross-company teams.
  • Strong critical thinking skills, including analysing, synthesising, and evaluating information.
  • Flexibility to work in fast-paced environments with changing priorities, combined with strong negotiation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering projects within the financial services or banking sector.
  • Experience as a functional or technical analyst.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, and other project management tools.
  • Certification in Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies (e.g. Scrum Master, Scrum Product Owner, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
  • Academic background in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.

Apply by submitting a CV in English.

About Euronext Securities

Euronext Securities is the Central Securities Depository (CSD) network connecting European economies to global capital markets. It is one of the largest CSD operators in Europe, providing secure and resilient settlement and custody solutions, as well as a comprehensive portfolio of services to support clients across the entire value chain.

Euronext Securities is building the infrastructure backbone of Europe's integrated capital markets. As part of this ambition, we are modernising our post-trade platform across multiple CSDs and delivering a European hub that will, from September 2026, allow market participants to manage Italy, France, Belgium, and the Netherlands through a single securities account. This transformation programme is one of the most significant in European post-trade history.

title: Therapist I - School Based Services - Grandview Elementary
description:
We are seeking a Therapist I- School Based Services (Grandview Elementary School) to join our team.

Salary Range: $50,000 - $58,000

This position will support students, families, and district personnel in the Grandview School District’s elementary schools to address personal, emotional and social problems that interfere with school adjustment and promote students’ academic success following a school social worker model. This position is a full-time twelve (12) month position per year. Nine (9) months of the year services will be provided in the district’s elementary schools. title: Reclaim & Screen Preparation Operator
description:
As a Reclaim & Screen Preparation Operator, you are a crucial and versatile link in our production process. You ensure that used printing screens are cleaned safely and thoroughly, and that new mesh is professionally stretched onto the frames. Because you work with chemical cleaning agents, stretching equipment, and industrial washers, safety, precision, and quality awareness are your top priorities.

Additionally, you are a hands-on team player with a flexible mindset: when needed, you willingly step in to assist other departments across the company to help achieve the best overall results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cleaning & Stripping (Reclaim): Remove ink residue, emulsion layers, and adhesives from used screen frames using chemical cleaning agents and high-pressure washers.
  • Screen Stretching: Remove old mesh, prep/sand frames, and professionally stretch new screen mesh onto frames to the required tension levels.
  • Process Control & Maintenance: Operate and maintain washing stations, tension meters, and chemical degreasers.
  • Quality Control: Inspect cleaned and newly stretched screens for correct mesh tension, damage, and complete removal of grease or ghost images.
  • Chemical Handling & Safety: Safely handle, dose, and store chemicals and frame adhesives in accordance with safety and environmental guidelines.
  • All-Round Duties & General Support:

title: Business Developer - Aftermarket & Services
description:
Last date to apply:

30 August 2026

Vil du kombinere stærke relationer, kommerciel udvikling og kundeoplevelser i en rolle med stor indflydelse?

Hos Husqvarna Group søger vi en Business Developer, der brænder for at skabe værdi for kunder og samarbejdspartnere. Du bliver en vigtig del af udviklingen af vores Aftermarket & Services-forretning i Danmark og får mulighed for at omsætte idéer, indsigter og relationer til konkrete resultater.

Din rolle

Du arbejder tæt sammen med forhandlere, kunder og kolleger på tværs af organisationen. Med fokus på samarbejde og forretningsudvikling er du med til at skabe vækst inden for reservedele, tilbehør og serviceydelser.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Udvikling af salget inden for Aftermarket & Services.
  • Opbygning af stærke og langvarige relationer med forhandlere og kunder.
  • Identifikation af nye forretningsmuligheder og kundeinitiativer.
  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af salgs- og markedsaktiviteter.
  • Anvendelse af kundeindsigt og markedsforståelse til at skabe værdi og vækst.

Hvem er du?

Du motiveres af at skabe relationer, udvikle forretning og gøre en positiv forskel for kunderne. Måske kommer du fra salg, retail, service eller forretningsudvikling. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og god til at skabe tillid.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med B2B-salg, forretningsudvikling eller kundevendte roller.
  • Er stærk til at samarbejde og opbygge relationer.
  • Trives med ansvar og selvstændighed.
  • Er struktureret og løsningsorienteret.
  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.
  • Har kørekort og lyst til at besøge kunder i hele Danmark.

Derfor skal du vælge Husqvarna Group

Hos os får du mere end et job. Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed med stærke brands, dygtige kolleger og et miljø, hvor samarbejde, udvikling og trivsel prioriteres højt.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En rolle med stor frihed og mulighed for at påvirke forretningen.
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med hjælpsomme kolleger.
  • Gode muligheder for personlig og professionel udvikling.
  • En varieret hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder og markedet.
  • Fleksibilitet og ansvar i en organisation med høj tillid.

Lokation

Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Værløse, men rollen foregår i høj grad tæt på forhandlerne, hvor størstedelen af dem er beliggende i Jylland. Derfor skal du trives med en hverdag, hvor du kombinerer kontordage hjemme eller på kontoret i Værløse med kundebesøg rundt i Danmark.

Klar til næste skridt?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i en rolle, hvor relationer, udvikling og kundeværdi går hånd i hånd, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge, uanset køn, baggrund eller erfaring fra branchen.

title: Tower Construction Technician - Oklahoma City, OK
description:
Tower Construction Technician

Locations: Santa Rosa, CA | Spokane, WA | Dallas - Fort Worth, TX | Oklahoma City, OK

Fully Onsite | No Travel Required | Full-Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations Inc. is seeking experienced Tower Construction Technicians to join our Integration & Infrastructure & Engineering (I&E) Division. This role supports FAA and government projects involving tower replacements, upgrades, and infrastructure modernization for the National Airspace System (NAS).

Technicians will perform civil construction and tower installation activities, including site preparation, tower assembly, equipment integration, and infrastructure buildout for communication towers and related facilities. This position requires hands-on expertise in construction environments while ensuring projects meet strict safety, regulatory, and performance standards.

This is a local hire position based in one of the locations listed above. This role is fully onsite with no travel required.

Opportunities for advancement include lead technician roles, project coordination, and involvement in emerging technologies such as UAS integration.

Key Responsibilities

Site Preparation & Civil Construction

  • Perform site excavation, trenching, foundation pouring, conduit installation, and backfilling for tower bases and supporting infrastructure.
  • Execute concrete forming and civil construction activities in accordance with engineering specifications.
  • Support site preparation and cleanup activities

Equipment Operation

  • Operate light to medium construction equipment including compact track loaders (CTL), mini-excavators, skid steers, and telehandlers.
  • Perform material handling and equipment movement safely and efficiently.
  • Operate equipment only when properly trained and authorized.

Tower Installation & Infrastructure

  • Assemble, erect, and upgrade communication towers including structural components, antenna mounts, and waveguide bridges.
  • Install and terminate RF cabling, coaxial lines, fiber optics, and hybrid cables with proper routing and weatherproofing.
  • Implement grounding systems, electrical wiring, surge protection, and bonding in accordance with NEC and FAA standards.
  • Perform tower climbing for inspections, installations, and maintenance; climbing certification preferred.
  • Decommission and remove legacy towers and equipment, including safe demolition and disposal.

Engineering & Coordination

  • Read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, site plans, and RF data sheets.
  • Coordinate with FAA personnel, subcontractors, and project managers to schedule outages, manage timelines, and resolve on-site issues.
  • Ensure compliance with safety protocols, environmental regulations, and quality assurance processes.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Document work progress and generate reports.
  • Maintain inventory of tools, materials, and equipment.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required for government contract work.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in tower construction, civil infrastructure, or telecommunications installation.
  • Proven experience with tower assembly, RF cabling, grounding, and electrical systems in aviation or telecommunications environments.
  • Proficiency operating light construction equipment such as CTL, excavators, or similar equipment.
  • Knowledge of civil construction practices including conduit work, trenching, and concrete forming.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance and meet background investigation requirements associated with federal contract work.
  • Basic computer skills for documentation and reporting, including Microsoft Office.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
  • Commitment to safety with experience following OSHA and FAA standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) for equipment transport.
  • Tower climbing certification and experience working at height.
  • OSHA 30-Hour Construction certification.
  • First Aid / CPR certification.
  • Rigging / Signal Person certification.
  • Familiarity with FAA Technical Operations and NAS infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting government contracts for tower upgrades.
  • Experience using tools such as cable testers, spectrum analyzers, torque wrenches, and hoisting equipment.
  • Knowledge of environmental considerations such as NEPA compliance or wildlife impact assessments.

Additional Role Considerations

  • Familiarity with hazardous materials handling, including HAZWOPER certification, may be beneficial.
  • Experience supporting sustainable construction practices or modern infrastructure initiatives.
  • Exposure to emerging technologies such as 5G integration for aviation environments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams and adapt to evolving project requirements.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 75 lbs.
  • Ability to climb towers and work at height.
  • Ability to operate heavy equipment safely.
  • Ability to work in extreme weather conditions including heat, cold, and high winds.
  • Work performed in outdoor construction environments with exposure to noise, heights, and jobsite hazards.
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required and provided.

Work Environment

  • Fully onsite position in the location assigned to.
  • Work performed at active construction sites and infrastructure locations.
  • Travel is not required for this role.

Compensation

Tower Construction Technician – $30.00 – $45.00 per hour

Compensation is determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity considerations.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, geographic considerations, and business needs.

Benefits

  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional Development Opportunities

Why Crown

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high-impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and shaping the future of air transportation.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful mission-driven work.

Persons unable to complete an online application should contact Crown HR for assistance at (703) 650-0663 ext. 3068.

Company Overview

Ethos Cannabis is a multi-state cannabis company with operations in the cultivation, processing and dispensing of cannabis in Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, and Ohio. Our goal is to have a clear and compelling consumer-centric vision focused on helping individuals feel and live better through their experiences with cannabis. Our mission is supported by our relationship with Jefferson Health, a leading academic medical center in the U.S., dedicated to collecting and analyzing valuable real-world data and developing educational initiatives with a focus on patient outcomes and quality of life. Cultivation Technicians are responsible for assisting the managers in the day-to-day functions of the cultivation production areas, including the propagation, cultivation, and harvest of cannabis plants. Successful Cultivation Technicians are energetic, detail-oriented, operational team players with strong communication skills and a can-do attitude. By closely following the training and guidance from the Management Team, Cultivation Technicians take the daily actions that result in the success of our crops and the quality of our product. Additionally, minimizing miscommunications and taking seriously the concerns of other cultivation team members ensures a safe and responsible workplace.

We are seeking a passionate, driven, detail-oriented and collaborative Cultivation Technician to support the company's cultivation activities. The ideal candidate has the ability to adapt to our business model and is a collaborative team player but also a self-starter. Previous cannabis cultivation experience is not required. Role reports to the Cultivation Manager.

title: System Validation Technical Program Manager - Server - Austin, TX or Secaucus, NJ
description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.





THE ROLE:

AMD’s Data Center Platform Engineering Group (DPEG) designs, builds, and delivers innovative technology infrastructure that powers the digital world. We develop cloud‑enabling server solutions that help the world’s leading companies turn ideas into reality. Our customers are future‑focused—and so are we—continuously staying ahead of the next challenge.

As experts across engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain, DPEG serves as the critical bridge between complex problems and scalable solutions for top cloud and telecom providers. Our customers rely on us to solve their most advanced server design challenges. Join our team and help build industry‑leading, high‑performance platforms along with talented and passionate people.

As part of the DC Platform Engineering organization, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) will lead the management and execution of AI and hyperscale server platform programs across the full product lifecycle—from product definition and planning through development, production, release, and end of life.

THE PERSON:

In this role, the Validation Technical Program Manager will serve as the key technical leader responsible for end‑to‑end rack‑level server solution validation. This position works cross‑functionally to define, develop, and execute comprehensive validation test strategies that ensure product functionality and compliance with specifications and requirements, including firmware and software stacks.

The role encompasses validation across board, system, and rack‑level integration, including electrical, power, mechanical, thermal, shock and vibration, compliance, system integration, platform validation, reliability, and firmware domains.

This individual will lead triage and debug efforts, identify root causes, and drive timely issue resolution. The role requires close collaboration with architecture, mechanical design, platform, firmware, and system engineering teams throughout all phases of the design process.

Strong judgment is essential in defining test specifications, requirements, strategies, and methodologies across electrical, firmware, and platform‑level validation. The TPM will lead test planning and execution, manage schedules, track requirements, summarize results, and develop validation documentation. The role also includes participation in both internal and customer‑facing program core team meetings to communicate status, track progress, and ensure readiness for key milestones. Additionally, this role provides hardware validation support for Internal Server R&D initiatives and contributes to system validation automation efforts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own server platform validation execution across board, system, and rack levels, ensuring alignment to program requirements and milestones.
  • Define and drive comprehensive validation test plans covering electrical, power, mechanical, thermal, shock & vibration, compliance, reliability, firmware, and system integration domains.
  • Partner closely with architecture, mechanical, platform, firmware, and system engineering teams to coordinate validation activities throughout the design lifecycle.
  • Apply sound technical judgment in developing test specifications, requirements, and methodologies for electrical, firmware, and platform‑level validation.
  • Manage validation schedules, requirement tracking, and execution progress, ensuring timely completion and clear communication of results.
  • Lead triage and debug activities, driving root‑cause identification and issue resolution while escalating risks as needed.
  • Prepare and maintain validation documentation, including test summaries, status reports, and milestone readiness inputs.
  • Represent validation in internal and customer‑facing program meetings, providing accurate status, risk awareness, and milestone readiness updates.
  • Support Internal Server R&D hardware validation efforts as required.
  • Contribute to validation automation efforts to improve test coverage, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Demonstrated expertise in defect management, issue tracking, root cause analysis, and cross-functional problem resolution.
  • Advanced experience using Jira for:
    • Defect tracking
    • Workflow management
    • Issue prioritization
    • Dashboard development
    • Burndown reporting
    • Executive status reporting

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience managing technical programs or workstreams across multiple cross‑functional teams with competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, track, and execute programs against defined requirements, schedules, and milestones.
  • Proficiency in program management fundamentals, including scope definition, schedule management, risk tracking, dependency management, and status reporting.
  • Experience driving cross‑functional alignment, facilitating reviews, and coordinating execution across engineering, validation, and partner teams.
  • Ability to identify, communicate, and escalate risks and issues with clear mitigation plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to present program status, risks, and readiness to internal and customer‑facing stakeholders.
  • Experience using program tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure, dashboards, MS Project, VISIO, spreadsheets) to monitor progress and report execution health.
  • Experience in server and datacenter validation, including board, system, and rack‑level hardware and software qualification
  • Working knowledge of server platform architectures, including PCIe, memory, storage, networking, compute, management, and system‑level integration.
  • Experience developing and executing validation test plans, test cases, and tracking progress against requirements and milestones.
  • Ability to support triage and debug efforts, manage defect tracking, and drive issue resolution in collaboration with cross‑functional engineering teams.
  • Experience in automation and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to improve validation efficiency and repeatability.
  • Solid understanding of validation methodologies to support reliable platform performance and milestone readiness.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, System Engineering or Computer Application or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, System Engineering or Computer Application.
  • Formal project management education, PMP / Scrum Master

Austin, TX or Secaucus, NJ

Who are we

Founded in 1896, Knight Frank was registered as Knight Frank LLP a Limited Liability Partnership, on 3 November 2003, registered in England & Wales at 55 Baker Street, London, W1U 8AN with the registered number of OC305934. Headquartered in London, UK, Knight Frank is one of the world's leading independent real estate consultancies. We work responsibly in partnership to enhance people's lives and environments in over 50 Markets, 600+ Offices, 20,000+ People, 1 Global Network.

At the heart of all we do are our Clients. A relationship built on trust is vital. As trusted partners in property, we act with integrity and care, understanding our clients’ unique needs and consistently thinking about the bigger picture to provide personalised, clear and considered advice across all areas of property. Through our deep understanding of key markets and sectors – both emerging and established – we are dedicated to meeting and exceeding their property goals.

A true partnership is a balanced one, and our People are passionate about, and committed to, making our business inclusive and diverse. We give every individual the space and opportunity to perform at their best and be recognised for the immense value they bring. We empower everyone to have autonomy in their role and encourage them to use their voice in how we can make a positive impact as a firm and shape the future of real estate, the built environment and the impact on the communities we serve. Our collaborative and engaged teams provide excellent and dedicated client service. In our workplace, opinions are respected, everyone is invited to contribute to the success of our business and innovation, and new ideas are celebrated.

In 2021 we celebrated our 125th anniversary and set out Our Desired Future, cemented in three pillars: People Potential, Client Centricity and always Creating our Future, together. Learn more about what sets us apart here.

About The Role

At Knight Frank, we advise clients across every stage of the property lifecycle, combining market-leading expertise with the strength of a global network. Our Commercial Valuations team provides valuation advice across a broad range of UK commercial property assets, acting for institutional investors, lenders, funds, property companies and private clients.

We are looking for a MRICS-qualified Surveyor to join our London-based Commercial Valuations team. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded valuer looking to further develop their career within one of the UK's leading property consultancies.

Working closely with senior colleagues and key clients, you will undertake valuations across a broad range of commercial property sectors throughout the UK, whilst playing an important role in the coordination and management of several major fund valuation instructions.

The Opportunity

As part of a highly respected team, you will be responsible for delivering valuation advice across a diverse range of commercial assets while acting as a key point of contact for a number of important client relationships.

Alongside valuation work, you will support the management of balanced fund instructions, working with Partners, Associates and Graduates to ensure exceptional service delivery and the highest professional standards.

This role offers excellent exposure to institutional clients, major lenders and nationally significant property portfolios, making it an ideal opportunity for someone looking to broaden their experience and build their profile within the industry.

What You'll Be Doing

In this role, you will:

  • Undertake valuations of commercial property assets across the UK for secured lending, accounting and advisory purposes.
  • Support the coordination and delivery of major fund valuation instructions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted point of contact.
  • Prepare clear, accurate and timely valuation reports.
  • Conduct detailed market research and analysis to support valuation advice.
  • Monitor market activity, legal developments and wider economic factors impacting the property market.
  • Support business development activities and identify opportunities to introduce clients to the wider Knight Frank service offering.
  • Develop and maintain internal and external professional networks.
  • Work closely with colleagues across Knight Frank to share market insight and identify cross-selling opportunities.
  • Support Partners, Associates and Graduates within the wider Valuation & Advisory team.
  • Ensure compliance with RICS standards, Knight Frank best practice and valuation governance processes.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an ambitious property professional who combines strong technical valuation capability with a client-focused mindset.

You will ideally bring:

Qualifications

  • MRICS qualified.
  • Registered under the RICS Valuer Registration Scheme.
  • Full UK driving licence.

Experience

  • Broad experience undertaking UK commercial property valuations.
  • Strong understanding of secured lending valuations and valuation methodology.
  • Experience working with institutional clients, lenders, property companies or funds.
  • Familiarity with a variety of commercial property sectors.

Skills & Attributes

  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong report-writing and communication skills.
  • Commercial awareness and an interest in the wider property market.
  • Strong analytical and numerical ability.
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to working with colleagues and clients.
  • Ability to manage multiple instructions and deliver to deadlines.
  • Enthusiasm for developing client relationships and contributing to business growth.

Systems & Technology

Experience of, or confidence using, the following systems would be advantageous:

  • Argus Enterprise
  • Argus Developer
  • KEL
  • MRI
  • Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint
  • LinkedIn

Knight Frank is the world's largest privately owned property consultancy, offering a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture where people are encouraged to build long-term careers.

You'll work alongside some of the industry's most respected valuation professionals, gain exposure to high-profile instructions and clients, and benefit from excellent career development opportunities within a market-leading business.

If you're looking to develop your valuation career in a supportive, ambitious and client-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to join Knight Frank as a Surveyor within our Commercial Valuations team.

Competitive salary

Please note: this is a Direct Search led by Knight Frank. Applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted nor will fees be paid for unsolicited CVs, even if provided by PSL agencies.

title: Field Service Engineer 2
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes.

The impact you’ll make

As a Field Service Engineer at Lam, you will step into the limelight of customer support. Your work goes beyond installations and troubleshooting; it ensures the operational excellence of our complex semiconductor equipment. You're on the front lines, understanding customer needs and collaborating with various teams to deliver solutions.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • Provide quality on-site repair, maintenance service, and complete installation/relocation start-up services of Lam’s complex electro-mechanical and electronic systems at customer sites.
  • Perform analytical problem-solving, troubleshooting, conduct diagnostics, isolate issues to the component level, and take corrective actions or request assistance to minimize downtime, system interruptions, and equipment malfunctions.
  • Keep up to date on semiconductor capital equipment and Lam products through learning, training, and certification.
  • Maintain records and reports to coordinate activities between Lam and the customer.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, representing Lam to our valued customers, delivering exceptional customer satisfaction.
  • Transparently discuss opportunities and challenges with customer to increase trust.
  • Update customer on status of Lam tools as needed.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Engineering, or related field with 2+ years of experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience.
  • Proficiency in interpreting electrical and mechanical schematics, diagrams, and operation manuals.
  • Able to work in a clean room environment while wearing personal protective safety equipment, or cleanroom suit.
  • Frequently position oneself (e.g., bend, stoop, reach, walk, sit, twist, squat, kneel, climb, stand) to perform job tasks for extended periods.
  • Able to travel frequently, domestically and internationally, based on customer needs, flexibility to work a variety shifts including compressed and alternative workweeks including overtime and on-call if needed.
  • This is a graduate eligible role.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in basic computer skills and familiarity with common office software including Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience in installation, maintenance, repair and troubleshooting of semiconductor capital equipment is a plus.
  • Communication skills, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Foundational analytical and problem-solving skills.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

title: Head of Viral Social (UGC & Clippers) at AIOS — Remote, $200k-$400k/yr + 0.15%-0.50%
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.
We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.
We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.
Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we’ve grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.
We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here:Working at AIOS

The opportunity as Head of Viral Social (UGC & Clippers)

We’re building a world-class team.

You’ll lead Viral Socials at AIOS, fully owning the system that turns UGC into predictable viral reach across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and creator-led channels.

Your fundamental role is to engineer attention at scale. You’ll build a repeatable virality engine that consistently turns short-form content into high-volume reach, engagement, and brand awareness.

You’ll own the entire UGC virality system end-to-end: sourcing creators, managing output quality, building AI-assisted workflows, coordinating clippers and editors, optimizing publishing cadence, and expanding distribution. You’ll nail building out repost ecosystems, meme pages, creator partnerships, and emerging formats.

You’ll design feedback loops between content creation, distribution, and performance, rapidly testing hooks, formats, narratives, and posting strategies to identify what spreads. You’ll then scale “winners” aggressively.

You’ll work closely with our Creative and Performance teams to turn social media into a scalable acquisition channel while maintaining quality and compliance.

Success in this role means building one of the highest-performing organic growth engines in consumer health, making all AIOS brands impossible to ignore online.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice. You must be around until midday Pacific Time every weekday to have enough crossover with me.

This is a senior role. You’ll report directly to our VP Growth (Rick Singh) and work closely with me, Richie :) (our CEO). I’m intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

You’ll work closely with our AI Growth Lead (Marie Boes) and our Ambassadors & Socials Lead (Erin Flores).

Key responsibilities

Areas

📷 “Never before in the history of humanity has it been possible to pick up a camera, talk for five seconds, and reach 100 million people. The power laws are extreme, where the top 1% of hits court 99% of the attention.”

Overall: You’ll turn UGC content into a high-velocity system that generates predictable viral reach at scale.

  • Own the viral content engine: You’ll orchestrate a new system to improve viral social content across Fella and Bolt, ensuring content is optimized for reach while remaining compliant.

  • Scale UGC and creator supply: You’ll build and manage a structured pipeline of both creators and content outputs, ensuring a consistent flow of high-performing UGC.

  • Architect Distribution : You’ll create and coordinate a network of clippers, meme pages, repost accounts, and creator partners to amplify reach beyond just owned channels.

  • Run the creative performance loop: You’ll constantly analyze performance, identifying winning patterns and feeding insights back into content creation and distribution.

  • Scale winners: You’ll unearth repeatable viral formats, then systematically scale them across creators, channels, and distribution paths.

  • Manage community and engagement: You’ll actively drive engagement across comments, shares, tags, and DMs to amplify reach and strengthen content performance.

KPIs

  • Primary KPI: Organic Branded Views on IG/TT/FB (last 30d)

    • 2026-05-21 = 2,544,013

    • Target = 40M

      • Base = 10M

      • Stretch = 150M

  • Secondary KPI: Organic Branded CPM (last 30d)

    • 2026-05-22 = £4.62

    • Target = £1.00

      • Base = £2.50

      • Stretch = £0.50

Need to have

  • Experience: You have 4+ years in social media, UGC, creator marketing, or viral content at high-growth brands or startups. You understand how to scale attention from 0 → 1 in fast-moving environments.

  • Viral Taste: You instinctively understand hooks, pacing, retention, captions, relatability, controversy, and platform-native behavior, and can turn those insights into repeatable formats that go viral.

  • Analysis: You are obsessed with performance, constantly testing creators, hooks, formats, posting strategies, and distribution channels. You lean heavily on your analytics to iterate rapidly.

  • UGC & Creator Operations: You know how to source creators, brief them effectively, manage deliverables, give actionable feedback, and build scalable UGC systems.

  • Founder vibes: You operate like a founder, proactively identifying opportunities, moving quickly, and treating all social channels like growth engines you fully own. You are hands-on and proactively solve problems so you don’t get blocked.

  • Strategy: You balance execution with long-term thinking. You understand platform shifts, audience psychology, distribution leverage, and when to take bold creative swings to keep growth compounding.

  • Brand & Compliance Balance: You understand that in health and weight-loss content, virality alone is not enough. You know how to push creative boundaries while staying compliant and aligned with brand standards.

Nice to have

  • Systems Thinking: You build systems that produce repeatable virality. You turn performance insights into scalable workflows.

  • High Agency: You’re a do-er. You move fast in ambiguity, learn quickly, and execute without needing structure or direction.

  • Category Insight (GLP-1 / Health Content): You understand the psychology of transformation, weight loss, and GLP-1 content, and what drives emotional engagement.

  • Creator Instincts: You deeply understand short-form content dynamics across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook. You especially stay on top of hooks, retention, and format shifts.

  • Distribution: You understand how to extend reach beyond owned channels through clippers, meme pages, repost networks, and creator ecosystems.

  • Paid Social Awareness: You can identify winning organic creatives and understand how they translate into scalable paid performance.

  • AI & Content Systems: You use AI and tooling to accelerate ideation, editing, and content iteration at high volume and speed.

  • Community: You understand how engagement compounds virality by building active audiences that amplify content reach and retention.

  • Hiring: You have a high talent bar and can identify elite internet-native creators, editors, and operators. You help build a lean, high-output team.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we’re average we fail: We are only interested in “insanely great”, a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn’t say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You’ll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 “You just build a fing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $200k-$400k/yr + 0.15%-0.50%

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free weekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free weekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Email

  • your resume

  • highlights from your experience relevant for the role

Or apply directly on Ashby here

title: EDM Administrator - 12 months assignment
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Master Data Administrator to join our Master Data Management team. In this role, you will serve as a frontline gatekeeper of our core MGE item master data.

You will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and auditing master data records across our enterprise systems (QAD) while ensuring strict adherence to data governance policies. If you thrive on bringing order to complexity, spotting inconsistencies before they become problems, and collaborating across teams to streamline processes, forms and workflows, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

Data Maintenance & Operations

  • Process Requests: Create, update, and deactivate master data records within agreed SLAs.

  • Ensure Data Accuracy: Perform initial validation checks to ensure complete, compliant, and standardized input.

  • Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve data-related transactional errors, system failures, and user inquiries in a timely manner.

Data Governance & Quality Control

  • Enforce Standards: Ensure all master data processes strictly comply with internal Data Governance policies, naming conventions, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Data Cleansing & Auditing: Conduct regular audits, routine data profiling, and deduplication exercises to maintain high data quality standards.

  • Documentation: Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for master data entry guidelines, workflows, and business rules.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Cross-Functional Support: Partner closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and IT to align data needs with business requirements.

  • Process Optimization: Identify recurring data bottlenecks or manual tasks and suggest opportunities for automation or workflow improvements.

  • Project Support: Assist in data mapping, migration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) during system upgrades or integration projects.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • 30 Days: Shadow the team, complete onboarding on our core ERP/MDM workflows, and take ownership of basic, day-to-day data entry requests.

  • 60 Days: Independently manage incoming master data tickets across core domains, adhering strictly to response SLAs and accuracy standards.

  • 90 Days: Identify at least one area for process improvement and present a plan to execute it alongside the MDM team.

What You Bring to the Table

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in master data management, data administration, business operations, or a related data stewardship role.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Hands-on experience with major ERP or enterprise systems (preferably QAD or Oracle, SAP).

  • Intermediate to advanced Google Workspace skills (GSheet, GDocs, Slides, Apps Script and Appsheet considered as a plus).

Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy and consistency when managing high volumes of alphanumeric data.

Team : strong cultural empathy and team player attitude

Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving ability to trace data discrepancies back to their root cause.

Communication: Clear written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to explain data standards to non-technical business users. French, German or Dutch considered as a plus.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with dedicated MDM tools (e.g., Informatica, Stibo Systems, Profisee, or SAP Master Data Governance).

  • Basic knowledge of SQL for querying databases.

  • Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks and data lifecycle management

Education

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent of hands-on working experience

What we offer

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

  • Health & Financial Benefits:
    *We offer a gross benefit for the supplemental package of mandatory health insurance.
    *Access to Lyra, our confidential Employee Assistance Program, for personal and professional support.
    *We provide a free health check every 4 years, and free fruit on-site.
    *Mandatory participation to the Avery Dennison Pension Fund, employer pays ⅔ of the premium.
    *Holiday allowance and a year-end allowance.

  • Time Off & Flexibility:
    *Annual Leave: Starting at 24 days, increasing to 26 days after 4 years (pro-rated).
    *Extra Days: 13 additional days per year (+4% ATV allowance, pro-rated) and a bridge day off. Benefit from birth/parental leave in accordance with Dutch labor law, with fully paid partner leave. We offer flexible working hours and hybrid work options for most positions.

  • Commuting & On-site Perks: Take advantage of free and enclosed parking in a well-located building, or opt for a commuting allowance/100% reimbursement for public transport.

  • Professional Development: Invest in your growth with a €500 annual individual training budget, access to lots of internal training/mentoring programs and a budget for hardware when working from home.

title: Liikenneasematyöntekijä Neste Huili Linnatuuli, Janakkala, Restel
description:
Haluatko työn, jossa voit aidosti piristää ihmisten päivää, kahvikuppi kerrallaan?

Etsimme liikenneasematyöntekijää Neste Linnatuuleen keikkatyösuhteeseen. Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian. Työvuorot painottuvat yövuoroihin, mutta voit mahdollisesti tehdä muitakin vuoroja liikenneaseman aukiolojen puitteissa.

Tässä työssä yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen ja saat aidosti monipuolisen työn: välillä palvelet asiakkaita, välillä valmistat ruokaa ja aina pidät huolen siitä, että tauko tuntuu asiakkaasta oikeasti hyvältä.

Huilissa et ole vain töissä - olet osa paikkaa, johon ihmiset pysähtyvät hengähtämään, syömään ja jatkamaan päivää vähän paremmalla fiiliksellä.

Hae ja testaa, olisiko Huili sun seuraava pysähdys.

Tykkäätkö siitä fiiliksestä, kun asiakas jatkaa päivää vähän paremmalla mielellä kuin tullessaan?

Tässä työssä kohtaat päivän aikana paljon erilaisia ihmisiä: vakioasiakkaita, työmatkalaisia, lapsiperheitä ja ohikulkijoita. Työ painottuu kassalle ja asiakaspalveluun, mutta päivään kuuluu myös myymälän ylläpitoa, tuotteiden esillepanoa, ruoan valmistusta sekä muita liikenneaseman arjen tehtäviä.

Tässä työssä pärjää, kun:

- Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja hyvästä asiakaspalvelusta huomioitasiakkaat luontevasti ja saat heidät tuntemaan olonsa tervetulleiksi
- Pysyt rauhallisena ja ystävällisenä myös kiireessä
- Tartut tehtäviin oma-aloitteisesti ja huolehdit ympäristöstäsi siisteydestä ja turvallisuudesta
- Pidät siitä, että jokainen päivä on hieman erilainen
Onnistumiset näkyvät nopeasti arjessa, kun asiakkaat palaavat uudelleen, ravintola näyttää houkuttelevalta ja taukohetki jää mieleen hyvällä tavalla. Saat perehdytyksen tehtävään, ja pääset kehittämään osaamistasi monipuolisessa työympäristössä.

Palkkaus määräytyy matkailu-, ravintola- ja vapaa-ajan palveluita koskevan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävässä onnistumista tukee sujuva suomen kielen taito, sillä työ sisältää asiakaspalvelua sekä työ- ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattamista. Englannin kielen osaaminen on plussaa.

Hae ja testaa, olisiko Huili sun seuraava pysähdys.

title: Over The Road Driver
description:
Harcros Chemicals is an employee-owned chemical manufacturing and distribution company headquartered in Kansas City, Kansas, with over a century of industry experience. With operations across North America and a nationwide distribution network, we deliver reliable, high-quality chemical solutions to customers worldwide across industries including water treatment, agriculture, oil and gas, personal care, and more. Safety, sustainability, and exceptional service are at the core of everything we do.

Join our Over The Road driving crew! Our driving teams celebrate our compensation package offerings such as:

  • Hourly rates between $28-$32 per hour depending on scheduled shift and location- make more than you would as a traditional mileage pay in less time!

  • Overtime pay starting at 40 hours worked per week (typical work weeks can offer regular OT opportunities)

  • Per Diem and cell phone stipend paid in addition to hourly rates

  • Home every weekend and 10+ holidays!

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Over-the-Road (OTR) Truck Driver is responsible for safely transporting freight across regional and national routes while ensuring compliance with DOT regulations and company policies. This role includes conducting vehicle inspections, securing and delivering loads, maintaining accurate logs and shipment documentation, and assisting with loading and unloading freight as needed. The ideal candidate possesses a valid Class A CDL with Tanker and HazMat endorsements, relevant OTR driving experience, a strong commitment to safety and customer service, and the ability to work independently in physically demanding environments and varying weather conditions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Transport Materials from vendors to company warehouses or directly to customers

  • Handle and inspect hazardous materials, manage records, and respond to spills or incidents following emergency action plans

  • Interpret customer orders, shipping papers, or purchase orders to schedule and execute deliveries or pickups

  • Pick up products, verify accuracy, and deliver to the appropriate location; collect payments for deliveries and services

  • Keep detailed truck logs in compliance with state and federal regulations

  • Efficiently load and unload goods, securing cargo for safe transit and returning empty containers as needed

  • Inspect and maintain truck equipment and supplies. Conduct emergency roadside repairs, replacing light bulbs and installing tire chains

  • Use load bars, straps, dunnage to secure items during transportation

​When not driving, additional responsibilities may include:

  • Generate, handle, and/or inspect hazardous waste and hazardous waste storage

  • Respond or manage hazardous waste spills and incidents based on the site’s emergency action or contingency plan

  • Prepare and manage hazardous waste records such as manifests, inspection logs, waste determination and other reports

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED)

  • 2+ years of experience or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Good standing with the Clearing House and clean MVR

  • Commercial license (Class A)

  • Hazardous Materials and Tank Endorsement required

Preferred

  • Forklift Operation experience preferred

Why Join Harcros Chemicals?

  • Employee-owned company where your contributions drive shared success

  • Competitive pay, bonus opportunities, and vehicle/car allowances for eligible roles

  • Comprehensive benefits, including multiple medical plan options, disability coverage, AD&D, and life insurance

  • Strong retirement benefits with ESOP participation, 401(k) and Roth options, company contributions, and early vesting

  • Access to Lyra mental health and wellness resources for employees and dependents starting day one

  • Supportive, team-focused culture that values collaboration and growth

  • 10 paid holidays, including one floating holiday

  • Opportunity to build a meaningful career with a company committed to excellence

In addition, you’ll coach cyber security staff from a technical SME perspective.
You’ll be responsible for security deliverables to project and change initiatives during early engagement, direct to approved architectural patterns, support and guide through implementation and validate the solution as part of certification prior to go-live.

Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organisation. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.

  • Preferably educated to a degree level or above in an Information Security related discipline or equivalent work experience. May also have certifications such as CISM, CISSP, CSSLP or equivalent.
  • Proven and repeatable experience implementing and managing security tooling suites covering areas such as Defender XDR, M365, Data Security, Web/Email controls.
  • Subject matter expert level experience of at least three of the above areas.
  • Current hands-on experience with m365 / Entra specifically Enterprise Apps, MDCA, App Registration, Identity Governance & Defender suite / XDR.
  • Experience managing and maintaining the smooth running of the Security tooling services and implementing changes in line with IT Service Management processes.
  • Providing technical leadership to a small team of security engineers, combining you SME knowledge and technical experience with research where required to provide guidance on the best answers to emerging challenges.
  • Experience in the financial services sector.
  • Ability to work in a constantly changing and fast past environment, switching between different change activities.
  • Ability to oversee and support the execution of the relevant controls associated with the tooling suites under your management.
  • Familiarity with a number of core security domains: IAM & PAM / Infrastructure / Cloud / Cryptography / Application / Data / SecOps.

WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT

At TSB, your contribution matters. We recognise the difference you make every day, and we make sure you feel valued, supported and rewarded in return.

We have an excellent benefits package which includes:

  • Extra 4% of your salary to either take as cash in your pay or to spend on flexible benefits (dental plan, cycle2work, buying extra holidays, etc.)
  • Car allowance
  • Variable Pay Award (10% on target) based on company performance.
  • Fantastic company pension – TSB contributing up to 13%
  • 30 days holidays (plus bank holidays)
  • Private Healthcare
  • Opportunities to grow your career within a global organisation

Ready to be recognised? It starts with you.

LOCAL COMPLIANCE
Inclusion matters at TSB. We want everyone to feel at home—whatever their background. Diverse teams help us deliver Money Confidence, for everyone, every day. Not sure you meet every requirement? If you tick some boxes and bring curiosity and openness, we’d love to hear from you. TSB is a Disability Confident Leader, if you meet the minimum criteria, we’ll ensure you’re considered.


We’re committed to creating a recruitment experience that’s accessible, fair and welcoming for all candidates.


When applying, please consider the travel distance, time and cost to your chosen office location.



WHAT TO DO NEXT
If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.
If there’s anything we can do in the recruitment process to help you achieve your best, get in touch. Whether it’s a copy of our application form in another format or additional assistance, we’re available through email. You can contact us at careers@tsb.co.uk

description:
Location:

Job Summary
Be a problem solver, trusted advisor, and partner to the people and businesses in our KeyBank communities. The Area Retail Leader (ARL) is responsible for the sales, service, and financial leadership of multiple branches in a defined geographic area. The ARL drives results through regular, in-person branch visits where they spend time observing and coaching the Branch Manager and their direct reports, partnering with the Branch Manager on joint calling efforts, and focusing on sale/revenue generation activities. The ARL has oversight of recruiting, hiring, training, and supervision of Branch Managers and their direct reports and ensures adherence to the staffing model for branches in their defined geographic areas. Essential Functions
